package com.uncode.app

import android.content.ComponentName
import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.content.SharedPreferences
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.content.pm.ResolveInfo
import android.util.Log

/**
 * LauncherStateManager
 *
 * Dedicated persistent state manager for QIEZKA's Home proxy target.
 * Stores and retrieves the user's selected real launcher (One UI, Nova, Lawnchair, etc.)
 * backed by SharedPreferences ("qiezka_home_proxy").
 *
 * Enforces Stage 1 Master Veto to guarantee that system settings, setup wizards,
 * or fallback activities can NEVER be persisted or selected as the target launcher.
 */
object LauncherStateManager {
    private const val TAG = "LauncherStateManager"
    const val PREFS_NAME = "qiezka_home_proxy"
    const val KEY_SELECTED_LAUNCHER_PKG = "selected_launcher_pkg"
    const val KEY_SELECTED_LAUNCHER_CLS = "selected_launcher_cls"
    const val ACTION_UPDATE_LAUNCHER = "com.siren.homeproxy.ACTION_UPDATE_LAUNCHER"
    const val SIREN_PACKAGE = "com.siren.homeproxy"

    /**
     * Actively pushes the launcher configuration to SIREN HomeProxy via explicit broadcast.
     * This avoids any 1-press delay or continuous polling on Home key clicks.
     */
    @JvmStatic
    fun notifySirenLauncherChanged(context: Context?, pkg: String?, cls: String?) {
        if (context == null) return
        try {
            val updateIntent = Intent(ACTION_UPDATE_LAUNCHER).apply {
                setPackage(SIREN_PACKAGE)
                if (!pkg.isNullOrBlank()) {
                    putExtra("package", pkg.trim())
                    putExtra("class", cls?.trim() ?: "")
                }
            }
            context.sendBroadcast(updateIntent)
            Log.i(TAG, "Dispatched ACTION_UPDATE_LAUNCHER to SIREN: pkg=$pkg, cls=$cls")
        } catch (t: Throwable) {
            Log.w(TAG, "Failed to broadcast launcher update to SIREN: ${t.message}")
        }
    }

    /**
     * Saves the chosen target launcher to persistent disk storage and actively pushes to SIREN.
     * Vetoes any package that fails Stage 1 Master Veto or attempts to set SIREN as its own target.
     */
    @JvmStatic
    fun saveSelectedLauncher(context: Context?, pkg: String?, cls: String?): Boolean {
        if (context == null || pkg.isNullOrBlank()) {
            return false
        }

        val trimmedPkg = pkg.trim()
        val trimmedCls = cls?.trim() ?: ""

        // Reject SIREN itself to prevent loopback
        if (SIREN_PACKAGE == trimmedPkg) {
            Log.w(TAG, "Cannot set SIREN itself as target launcher")
            return false
        }

        // Stage 1 Master Veto Protection & Distraction Rejection: Reject Settings, Device Care, Setup Wizards, Bloatware, Distractions
        if (AppClassifier.isStage1Vetoed(trimmedPkg, null) || KnownDistracting.isKnownDistracting(trimmedPkg)) {
            Log.w(TAG, "Attempted to save vetoed package as launcher: $trimmedPkg")
            return false
        }

        return try {
            val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            prefs.edit()
                .putString(KEY_SELECTED_LAUNCHER_PKG, trimmedPkg)
                .putString(KEY_SELECTED_LAUNCHER_CLS, trimmedCls)
                .apply()
            Log.i(TAG, "Saved selected launcher: $trimmedPkg / $trimmedCls")
            notifySirenLauncherChanged(context, trimmedPkg, trimmedCls)
            true
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Failed to save selected launcher: ${e.message}")
            false
        }
    }

    /**
     * Clears the explicitly saved launcher from persistent disk storage
     * and signals SIREN HomeProxy to fall back to auto-discovery.
     */
    @JvmStatic
    fun clearSelectedLauncher(context: Context?) {
        if (context == null) return
        try {
            val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            prefs.edit()
                .remove(KEY_SELECTED_LAUNCHER_PKG)
                .remove(KEY_SELECTED_LAUNCHER_CLS)
                .apply()
            Log.i(TAG, "Cleared selected launcher")
            notifySirenLauncherChanged(context, null, null)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Failed to clear selected launcher: ${e.message}")
        }
    }

    /**
     * Retrieves the current selected launcher component.
     * If no launcher is explicitly saved, or if the saved launcher is invalid/corrupted,
     * it auto-discovers and persists the best installed real launcher (excluding QIEZKA and fallbacks).
     */
    @JvmStatic
    fun getSelectedLauncher(context: Context?): ComponentName? {
        if (context == null) return null

        val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        var savedPkg = prefs.getString(KEY_SELECTED_LAUNCHER_PKG, null)
        var savedCls = prefs.getString(KEY_SELECTED_LAUNCHER_CLS, null)

        // Sanitize: Purge if vetoed by Stage 1 Master Veto or Distraction (e.g. legacy com.android.settings or games)
        if (savedPkg != null && (AppClassifier.isStage1Vetoed(savedPkg, null) || KnownDistracting.isKnownDistracting(savedPkg))) {
            Log.w(TAG, "Purging vetoed launcher from prefs: $savedPkg")
            prefs.edit()
                .remove(KEY_SELECTED_LAUNCHER_PKG)
                .remove(KEY_SELECTED_LAUNCHER_CLS)
                .apply()
            savedPkg = null
            savedCls = null
        }

        val pm = context.packageManager ?: return null

        // If saved launcher exists and is valid on device, return it
        if (!savedPkg.isNullOrEmpty()) {
            if (!savedCls.isNullOrEmpty()) {
                try {
                    pm.getActivityInfo(ComponentName(savedPkg, savedCls), 0)
                    return ComponentName(savedPkg, savedCls)
                } catch (ignore: Exception) {}
            }
            // Resolve default activity if class name wasn't specified
            try {
                val homeIntent = Intent(Intent.ACTION_MAIN).addCategory(Intent.CATEGORY_HOME).setPackage(savedPkg)
                val matches = pm.queryIntentActivities(homeIntent, PackageManager.MATCH_DEFAULT_ONLY)
                if (!matches.isNullOrEmpty() && matches[0].activityInfo != null) {
                    val actName = matches[0].activityInfo.name
                    return ComponentName(savedPkg, actName)
                }
            } catch (ignore: Exception) {}
        }

        // Auto-discover genuine installed launchers (excluding self, FallbackHome, SIREN, and settings)
        try {
            val queryIntent = Intent(Intent.ACTION_MAIN).addCategory(Intent.CATEGORY_HOME)
            val candidates = pm.queryIntentActivities(queryIntent, 0)

            for (info in candidates) {
                if (InstalledLauncherDetector.isRealLauncher(info, context.packageName)) {
                    val pkg = info.activityInfo.packageName
                    if (SIREN_PACKAGE.equals(pkg, ignoreCase = true)) continue
                    val cls = info.activityInfo.name
                    if (saveSelectedLauncher(context, pkg, cls)) {
                        Log.i(TAG, "Auto-discovered and set target launcher: $pkg / $cls")
                        return ComponentName(pkg, cls)
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Error discovering launcher: ${e.message}")
        }

        return null
    }
}

package com.uncode.app

import android.app.Notification

/**
 * LocalDnsVpnService:
 * Ultra-lightweight loopback Android VpnService that operates entirely on-device.
 *
 * It only routes traffic for its virtual DNS IP (10.111.222.1/32 and fd00:111:222::1/128).
 * All standard TCP/HTTPS connections (Chrome, apps, streaming) flow directly
 * over Wi-Fi / Cellular with ZERO latency overhead and 100% BYOK privacy.
 *
 * For DNS queries:
 * - Distracting/blacklisted domains (TikTok, Instagram, Reddit, etc.) are sinkholed to NXDOMAIN.
 * - Allowed study/research domains are forwarded to upstream DNS (1.1.1.1 / 8.8.8.8) via protected sockets.
 */
class LocalDnsVpnService : VpnService() {

    companion object {
        private const val TAG = "LocalDnsVpnService"
        private const val CHANNEL_ID = "qiezka_dns_vpn"
        private const val NOTIF_ID = 8801
        private const val PREFS_NAME = "uncode_lock"

        const val ACTION_STOP = "com.uncode.app.ACTION_STOP_VPN"

        @JvmField
        @Volatile
        var isRunning: Boolean = false

        @Volatile
        private var sInstance: LocalDnsVpnService? = null

        private const val VPN_INTERFACE_IP = "10.111.222.1"
        private const val VPN_DNS_SERVER_IP = "10.111.222.2"
        private const val VPN_INTERFACE_IPV6 = "fd00:111:222::1"
        private const val VPN_DNS_SERVER_IPV6 = "fd00:111:222::2"

        @JvmStatic
        fun startVpn(context: Context) {
            if (isRunning) return
            try {
                val intent = Intent(context, LocalDnsVpnService::class.java)
                if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
                    context.startForegroundService(intent)
                } else {
                    context.startService(intent)
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Failed to start LocalDnsVpnService: ${e.message}")
            }
        }

        @JvmStatic
        fun stopVpn(context: Context?) {
            isRunning = false

            // 1. Direct synchronous teardown of active TUN interface & worker threads
            val instance = sInstance
            if (instance != null) {
                try {
                    instance.stopDnsSinkhole()
                    instance.stopSelf()
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    Log.w(TAG, "Direct instance teardown warning: ${e.message}")
                }
            }

            // 2. Standard Android service teardown via stopService
            if (context != null) {
                try {
                    val stopIntent = Intent(context, LocalDnsVpnService::class.java)
                    context.stopService(stopIntent)
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    Log.w(TAG, "Failed to call context.stopService: ${e.message}")
                }
            }
        }

        @JvmStatic
        fun updateNotification(context: Context?) {
            if (!isRunning || context == null) return
            try {
                val instance = sInstance
                if (instance != null) {
                    val notif = instance.buildNotification()
                    val nm = instance.getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as? NotificationManager
                    nm?.notify(NOTIF_ID, notif)
                    return
                }
                val intent = Intent(context, LocalDnsVpnService::class.java).apply {
                    action = "ACTION_UPDATE_NOTIF"
                }
                if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
                    context.startForegroundService(intent)
                } else {
                    context.startService(intent)
                }
            } catch (ignore: Exception) {}
        }
    }

    private var vpnInterface: ParcelFileDescriptor? = null
    private var workerThread: Thread? = null
    private var dnsExecutor: ExecutorService? = null
    @Volatile
    private var shouldRun: Boolean = false

    override fun onCreate() {
        super.onCreate()
        sInstance = this
    }

    override fun onStartCommand(intent: Intent?, flags: Int, startId: Int): Int {
        if (intent != null && ACTION_STOP == intent.action) {
            Log.i(TAG, "Received ACTION_STOP: cleanly closing tun0 and stopping service")
            stopDnsSinkhole()
            stopSelf()
            return START_NOT_STICKY
        }

        createNotificationChannel()
        val notif = buildNotification()

        if (intent != null && "ACTION_UPDATE_NOTIF" == intent.action) {
            try {
                if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 34) {
                    startForeground(NOTIF_ID, notif, ServiceInfo.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_SYSTEM_EXEMPTED)
                } else if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q) {
                    startForeground(NOTIF_ID, notif, ServiceInfo.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_SYSTEM_EXEMPTED)
                } else {
                    startForeground(NOTIF_ID, notif)
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                val nm = getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as? NotificationManager
                nm?.notify(NOTIF_ID, notif)
            }
            return START_STICKY
        }

        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 34) {
            try {
                startForeground(NOTIF_ID, notif, ServiceInfo.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_SYSTEM_EXEMPTED)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                Log.w(TAG, "systemExempted startForeground failed, falling back to specialUse: ${e.message}")
                startForeground(NOTIF_ID, notif, ServiceInfo.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_SPECIAL_USE)
            }
        } else if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q) {
            try {
                startForeground(NOTIF_ID, notif, ServiceInfo.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_SYSTEM_EXEMPTED)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                startForeground(NOTIF_ID, notif, ServiceInfo.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_SPECIAL_USE)
            }
        } else {
            startForeground(NOTIF_ID, notif)
        }

        startDnsSinkhole()
        return START_STICKY
    }

    override fun onDestroy() {
        stopDnsSinkhole()
        try {
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.N) {
                stopForeground(STOP_FOREGROUND_REMOVE)
            } else {
                @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
                stopForeground(true)
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.w(TAG, "stopForeground error: ${e.message}")
        }
        if (sInstance == this) {
            sInstance = null
        }
        super.onDestroy()
    }

    @Synchronized
    private fun startDnsSinkhole() {
        if (workerThread != null && workerThread?.isAlive == true) return

        try {
            val builder = Builder().apply {
                setSession("QIEZKA DNS Guard")
                setMtu(1500)
                addAddress(VPN_INTERFACE_IP, 24)
                addDnsServer(VPN_DNS_SERVER_IP)
                addRoute(VPN_DNS_SERVER_IP, 32) // Virtual DNS IP

                // IPv6 Virtual Interface & DNS
                try {
                    addAddress(VPN_INTERFACE_IPV6, 128)
                    addDnsServer(VPN_DNS_SERVER_IPV6)
                    addRoute(VPN_DNS_SERVER_IPV6, 128)
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    Log.w(TAG, "IPv6 address/DNS configuration warning: ${e.message}")
                }

                // Route common public DNS servers
                try {
                    addRoute("8.8.8.8", 32)
                    addRoute("8.8.4.4", 32)
                    addRoute("1.1.1.1", 32)
                    addRoute("1.0.0.1", 32)
                    addRoute("9.9.9.9", 32)
                    addRoute("208.67.222.222", 32)
                    addRoute("208.67.220.220", 32)
                    addRoute("94.140.14.14", 32)
                    addRoute("94.140.15.15", 32)
                    addRoute("2001:4860:4860::8888", 128)
                    addRoute("2001:4860:4860::8844", 128)
                    addRoute("2606:4700:4700::1111", 128)
                    addRoute("2606:4700:4700::1001", 128)
                    addRoute("2620:fe::fe", 128)
                    addRoute("2620:fe::9", 128)
                    addRoute("180.76.76.200", 32) // Baidu HTTPDNS primary
                    addRoute("180.76.76.76", 32)  // Baidu HTTPDNS secondary
                    addRoute("203.107.1.1", 32)   // Alibaba HTTPDNS primary
                    addRoute("203.107.1.33", 32)  // Alibaba HTTPDNS secondary
                    addRoute("119.29.29.29", 32)  // Tencent HTTPDNS
                } catch (ignore: Exception) {}

                // Intercept all physical networks' underlying DNS servers
                try {
                    val cm = getSystemService(Context.CONNECTIVITY_SERVICE) as? ConnectivityManager
                    if (cm != null) {
                        val allNets = cm.allNetworks
                        for (net in allNets) {
                            val caps = cm.getNetworkCapabilities(net)
                            if (caps != null && caps.hasTransport(NetworkCapabilities.TRANSPORT_VPN)) {
                                continue
                            }
                            val lp = cm.getLinkProperties(net)
                            if (lp != null) {
                                for (dns in lp.dnsServers) {
                                    val host = dns.hostAddress
                                    if (host != null) {
                                        if (dns is Inet4Address) {
                                            addRoute(host, 32)
                                        } else if (dns is Inet6Address) {
                                            addRoute(host, 128)
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                } catch (ignore: Exception) {}

                try {
                    addDisallowedApplication(packageName)
                } catch (ignore: Exception) {}

                setBlocking(true)
            }

            vpnInterface = builder.establish()
            if (vpnInterface == null) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Failed to establish VPN interface (prepare() may be required)")
                stopSelf()
                return
            }

            shouldRun = true
            isRunning = true

            dnsExecutor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(8)
            workerThread = Thread(DnsWorker(), "QiezkaDnsWorker").apply {
                start()
            }
            Log.i(TAG, "LocalDnsVpnService started successfully. Interface=$VPN_INTERFACE_IP, DNS=$VPN_DNS_SERVER_IP")
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Error establishing DNS VPN: ${e.message}", e)
            stopSelf()
        }
    }

    @Synchronized
    private fun stopDnsSinkhole() {
        shouldRun = false
        isRunning = false

        workerThread?.interrupt()
        workerThread = null

        dnsExecutor?.shutdownNow()
        dnsExecutor = null

        vpnInterface?.let {
            try {
                it.close()
            } catch (ignore: Exception) {}
            vpnInterface = null
        }

        try {
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.N) {
                stopForeground(STOP_FOREGROUND_REMOVE)
            } else {
                @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
                stopForeground(true)
            }
        } catch (ignore: Exception) {}

        Log.i(TAG, "LocalDnsVpnService stopped")
    }

    private inner class DnsWorker : Runnable {
        override fun run() {
            val vpn = vpnInterface ?: return

            val `in` = FileInputStream(vpn.fileDescriptor)
            val out = FileOutputStream(vpn.fileDescriptor)
            val buffer = ByteArray(32767)

            val prefs = getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)

            while (shouldRun && !Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted) {
                try {
                    val length = `in`.read(buffer)
                    if (length <= 0) continue

                    val version = (buffer[0].toInt() shr 4) and 0x0F
                    val isIpv6 = (version == 6)
                    val ipHeaderLength: Int
                    val srcPort: Int
                    val dstPort: Int
                    val dnsOffset: Int
                    val dnsLength: Int

                    if (version == 4) {
                        if (length < 28) continue
                        val protocol = buffer[9].toInt() and 0xFF
                        if (protocol != 17) continue // UDP only (17)
                        ipHeaderLength = (buffer[0].toInt() and 0x0F) * 4
                        if (length < ipHeaderLength + 8) continue
                        srcPort = ((buffer[ipHeaderLength].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 8) or (buffer[ipHeaderLength + 1].toInt() and 0xFF)
                        dstPort = ((buffer[ipHeaderLength + 2].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 8) or (buffer[ipHeaderLength + 3].toInt() and 0xFF)
                        dnsOffset = ipHeaderLength + 8
                        dnsLength = length - dnsOffset
                    } else if (version == 6) {
                        if (length < 48) continue // 40-byte IPv6 header + 8-byte UDP header
                        val nextHeader = buffer[6].toInt() and 0xFF
                        if (nextHeader != 17) continue // UDP only
                        ipHeaderLength = 40
                        srcPort = ((buffer[40].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 8) or (buffer[41].toInt() and 0xFF)
                        dstPort = ((buffer[42].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 8) or (buffer[43].toInt() and 0xFF)
                        dnsOffset = 48
                        dnsLength = length - dnsOffset
                    } else {
                        continue
                    }

                    if (dstPort != 53) continue // Only handle DNS queries
                    if (dnsLength < 12) continue // Minimum DNS header size

                    val packetData = Arrays.copyOf(buffer, length)
                    val finalIsIpv6 = isIpv6
                    val finalIpHeaderLen = ipHeaderLength
                    val finalSrcPort = srcPort
                    val finalDstPort = dstPort
                    val finalDnsOffset = dnsOffset
                    val finalDnsLength = dnsLength

                    val executor = dnsExecutor
                    if (executor != null && !executor.isShutdown) {
                        executor.execute {
                            try {
                                handleDnsPacket(
                                    packetData,
                                    finalIsIpv6,
                                    finalIpHeaderLen,
                                    finalSrcPort,
                                    finalDstPort,
                                    finalDnsOffset,
                                    finalDnsLength,
                                    prefs,
                                    out
                                )
                            } catch (e: Exception) {
                                Log.d(TAG, "handleDnsPacket error: ${e.message}")
                            }
                        }
                    }
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    if (!shouldRun) break
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun handleDnsPacket(
        packet: ByteArray,
        isIpv6: Boolean,
        ipHeaderLength: Int,
        srcPort: Int,
        dstPort: Int,
        dnsOffset: Int,
        dnsLength: Int,
        prefs: SharedPreferences,
        out: FileOutputStream
    ) {
        val queryDomain = parseDnsQuestionDomain(packet, dnsOffset, packet.size) ?: ""
        val lowerDomain = queryDomain.toLowerCase(Locale.US)

        val isLockdown = prefs.getBoolean("lockdown_active", false)
        val isConsequence = prefs.getBoolean("consequence_active", false)
        val isEnforcing = isLockdown || isConsequence

        // Defense-in-depth: if system is in idle free time (no active session), bypass WebClassifier
        if (!isEnforcing) {
            val dnsPayload = Arrays.copyOfRange(packet, dnsOffset, dnsOffset + dnsLength)
            val upstreamResponse = forwardToUpstreamDns(dnsPayload, prefs)
            if (upstreamResponse != null) {
                val responseIpPacket = if (isIpv6) {
                    buildUdpIp6Packet(packet, dstPort, srcPort, upstreamResponse)
                } else {
                    buildUdpIpPacket(packet, ipHeaderLength, dstPort, srcPort, upstreamResponse)
                }
                synchronized(out) {
                    try {
                        out.write(responseIpPacket)
                    } catch (ignore: Exception) {}
                }
            }
            return
        }

        val allowYoutube = prefs.getBoolean("allow_youtube", false)
        val activeServiceIds = prefs.getStringSet("active_unified_services", null)
        val allowedDomains = HashSet<String>(UnifiedPolicyRegistry.getDomainsForServices(activeServiceIds))
        val customAllowed = prefs.getStringSet("allowed_domains", null)
        if (customAllowed != null) allowedDomains.addAll(customAllowed)
        if (allowYoutube) {
            val yt = UnifiedPolicyRegistry.SERVICES["youtube"]
            if (yt != null) allowedDomains.addAll(yt.domains)
        }

        // 1. Check if domain is blocked via WebClassifier multi-genre intelligence
        val classResult = WebClassifier.classifyDomain(lowerDomain, allowYoutube, allowedDomains)
        if (classResult.isBlocked) {
            // Synthesize local sinkhole NXDOMAIN response
            val responseDns = buildSinkholeResponse(packet, dnsOffset, dnsLength)
            if (responseDns != null) {
                val responseIpPacket = if (isIpv6) {
                    buildUdpIp6Packet(packet, dstPort, srcPort, responseDns)
                } else {
                    buildUdpIpPacket(packet, ipHeaderLength, dstPort, srcPort, responseDns)
                }
                synchronized(out) {
                    try {
                        out.write(responseIpPacket)
                    } catch (ignore: Exception) {}
                }
                Log.d(TAG, "Sinkholed DNS query (NXDOMAIN): $queryDomain -> ${classResult.reason}")
            }
            return
        }

        // 2. Forward legitimate study/research query to upstream DNS resolver (Cloudflare / Google)
        val dnsPayload = Arrays.copyOfRange(packet, dnsOffset, dnsOffset + dnsLength)
        val upstreamResponse = forwardToUpstreamDns(dnsPayload, prefs)
        if (upstreamResponse != null) {
            val responseIpPacket = if (isIpv6) {
                buildUdpIp6Packet(packet, dstPort, srcPort, upstreamResponse)
            } else {
                buildUdpIpPacket(packet, ipHeaderLength, dstPort, srcPort, upstreamResponse)
            }
            synchronized(out) {
                try {
                    out.write(responseIpPacket)
                } catch (ignore: Exception) {}
            }
        }
    }

    private fun parseDnsQuestionDomain(packet: ByteArray, dnsOffset: Int, totalLength: Int): String? {
        var pos = dnsOffset + 12 // Skip 12-byte header
        val sb = StringBuilder()

        while (pos < totalLength) {
            val labelLen = packet[pos].toInt() and 0xFF
            if (labelLen == 0) break
            pos++
            if (pos + labelLen > totalLength) return null

            if (sb.isNotEmpty()) sb.append('.')
            for (i in 0 until labelLen) {
                sb.append((packet[pos + i].toInt() and 0xFF).toChar())
            }
            pos += labelLen
        }
        return sb.toString()
    }

    /**
     * Calculates the exact byte length of the DNS Question section.
     */
    private fun getDnsQuestionLength(packet: ByteArray, dnsOffset: Int, totalLength: Int): Int {
        var pos = dnsOffset + 12
        while (pos < totalLength) {
            val labelLen = packet[pos].toInt() and 0xFF
            if (labelLen == 0) {
                pos++
                break
            }
            pos += 1 + labelLen
        }
        if (pos + 4 <= totalLength) {
            return (pos + 4) - (dnsOffset + 12)
        }
        return Math.max(0, totalLength - (dnsOffset + 12))
    }

    private fun buildSinkholeResponse(packet: ByteArray, dnsOffset: Int, dnsLength: Int): ByteArray? {
        return try {
            val qLen = getDnsQuestionLength(packet, dnsOffset, packet.size)
            val respLen = 12 + qLen
            val buf = ByteBuffer.allocate(respLen)

            // 1. Transaction ID (2 bytes)
            buf.put(packet[dnsOffset])
            buf.put(packet[dnsOffset + 1])

            // 2. Flags: Response, Opcode 0, Authoritative, Recursion Available, RCODE = 3 (NXDOMAIN)
            buf.put(0x81.toByte())
            buf.put(0x83.toByte())

            // 3. QDCOUNT = 1, ANCOUNT = 0, NSCOUNT = 0, ARCOUNT = 0
            buf.putShort(1.toShort())
            buf.putShort(0.toShort())
            buf.putShort(0.toShort())
            buf.putShort(0.toShort())

            // 4. Copy strictly the Question Section
            buf.put(packet, dnsOffset + 12, qLen)

            Arrays.copyOf(buf.array(), buf.position())
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            null
        }
    }

    private fun parseDnsQuestionType(packet: ByteArray, dnsOffset: Int, totalLength: Int): Int {
        var pos = dnsOffset + 12
        while (pos < totalLength) {
            val labelLen = packet[pos].toInt() and 0xFF
            if (labelLen == 0) {
                pos++
                break
            }
            pos += 1 + labelLen
        }
        if (pos + 2 <= totalLength) {
            return ((packet[pos].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 8) or (packet[pos + 1].toInt() and 0xFF)
        }
        return 1 // Default to Type A
    }

    private fun buildARecordResponse(packet: ByteArray, dnsOffset: Int, dnsLength: Int, ipBytes: ByteArray): ByteArray? {
        return try {
            val qLen = getDnsQuestionLength(packet, dnsOffset, packet.size)
            val respLen = 12 + qLen + 16
            val buf = ByteBuffer.allocate(respLen)

            // 1. Transaction ID (2 bytes)
            buf.put(packet[dnsOffset])
            buf.put(packet[dnsOffset + 1])

            // 2. Flags: Response, Opcode 0, Authoritative, Recursion Available, RCODE = 0 (NOERROR)
            buf.put(0x81.toByte())
            buf.put(0x80.toByte())

            // 3. QDCOUNT = 1, ANCOUNT = 1, NSCOUNT = 0, ARCOUNT = 0
            buf.putShort(1.toShort())
            buf.putShort(1.toShort())
            buf.putShort(0.toShort())
            buf.putShort(0.toShort())

            // 4. Copy strictly the Question Section
            buf.put(packet, dnsOffset + 12, qLen)

            // 5. Answer Section (Compression pointer to Question at offset 12 -> 0xC00C)
            buf.put(0xC0.toByte())
            buf.put(0x0C.toByte())
            buf.putShort(1.toShort()) // Type A
            buf.putShort(1.toShort()) // Class IN
            buf.putInt(300)          // TTL: 300s
            buf.putShort(4.toShort()) // Data length: 4 bytes
            buf.put(ipBytes)

            Arrays.copyOf(buf.array(), buf.position())
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            null
        }
    }

    private fun buildNoDataResponse(packet: ByteArray, dnsOffset: Int, dnsLength: Int): ByteArray? {
        return try {
            val qLen = getDnsQuestionLength(packet, dnsOffset, packet.size)
            val respLen = 12 + qLen
            val buf = ByteBuffer.allocate(respLen)

            // 1. Transaction ID (2 bytes)
            buf.put(packet[dnsOffset])
            buf.put(packet[dnsOffset + 1])

            // 2. Flags: Response, Opcode 0, Authoritative, Recursion Available, RCODE = 0 (NOERROR)
            buf.put(0x81.toByte())
            buf.put(0x80.toByte())

            // 3. QDCOUNT = 1, ANCOUNT = 0, NSCOUNT = 0, ARCOUNT = 0
            buf.putShort(1.toShort())
            buf.putShort(0.toShort())
            buf.putShort(0.toShort())
            buf.putShort(0.toShort())

            // 4. Copy strictly the Question Section
            buf.put(packet, dnsOffset + 12, qLen)

            Arrays.copyOf(buf.array(), buf.position())
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            null
        }
    }

    private fun getUpstreamDnsServers(prefs: SharedPreferences): List<InetAddress> {
        val servers = ArrayList<InetAddress>()
        addDnsServer(servers, "1.1.1.1")
        addDnsServer(servers, "1.0.0.1")
        addDnsServer(servers, "8.8.8.8")
        addDnsServer(servers, "8.8.4.4")
        addDnsServer(servers, "2606:4700:4700::1111")
        addDnsServer(servers, "2001:4860:4860::8888")

        try {
            val cm = getSystemService(Context.CONNECTIVITY_SERVICE) as? ConnectivityManager
            if (cm != null) {
                val allNets = cm.allNetworks
                for (net in allNets) {
                    val caps = cm.getNetworkCapabilities(net)
                    if (caps != null && caps.hasTransport(NetworkCapabilities.TRANSPORT_VPN)) {
                        continue
                    }
                    val lp = cm.getLinkProperties(net)
                    if (lp != null) {
                        for (dns in lp.dnsServers) {
                            if (!servers.contains(dns)) {
                                servers.add(dns)
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (ignore: Exception) {}

        return servers
    }

    private fun addDnsServer(list: MutableList<InetAddress>, ip: String) {
        try {
            list.add(InetAddress.getByName(ip))
        } catch (ignore: Exception) {}
    }

    private fun forwardToUpstreamDns(queryPayload: ByteArray, prefs: SharedPreferences): ByteArray? {
        val upstreamServers = getUpstreamDnsServers(prefs)
        var socket: DatagramSocket? = null
        try {
            socket = DatagramSocket()
            protect(socket) // ESSENTIAL: Exclude this socket from the VPN TUN interface!
            socket.soTimeout = 1200

            for (server in upstreamServers) {
                try {
                    val outPacket = DatagramPacket(queryPayload, queryPayload.size, server, 53)
                    socket.send(outPacket)

                    val recvBuf = ByteArray(2048)
                    val inPacket = DatagramPacket(recvBuf, recvBuf.size)
                    socket.receive(inPacket)

                    return Arrays.copyOf(inPacket.data, inPacket.length)
                } catch (nextServer: Exception) {
                    // Try next upstream server
                }
            }
            return null
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            return null
        } finally {
            if (socket != null && !socket.isClosed) {
                socket.close()
            }
        }
    }

    private fun buildUdpIpPacket(
        origPacket: ByteArray,
        ipHeaderLen: Int,
        newSrcPort: Int,
        newDstPort: Int,
        udpPayload: ByteArray
    ): ByteArray {
        val totalLen = 20 + 8 + udpPayload.size
        val ipPacket = ByteArray(totalLen)

        // IPv4 Header
        ipPacket[0] = 0x45.toByte() // IPv4, Header length = 5 (20 bytes)
        ipPacket[1] = 0x00.toByte() // DSCP / ECN
        ipPacket[2] = ((totalLen shr 8) and 0xFF).toByte()
        ipPacket[3] = (totalLen and 0xFF).toByte()
        ipPacket[4] = 0x00.toByte()
        ipPacket[5] = 0x01.toByte() // ID
        ipPacket[6] = 0x00.toByte()
        ipPacket[7] = 0x00.toByte() // Flags & Fragment Offset
        ipPacket[8] = 64.toByte()   // TTL
        ipPacket[9] = 17.toByte()   // Protocol: UDP

        // Swap Source IP and Destination IP
        System.arraycopy(origPacket, 16, ipPacket, 12, 4) // New src IP = orig dst IP (10.111.222.1)
        System.arraycopy(origPacket, 12, ipPacket, 16, 4) // New dst IP = orig src IP

        // IP Checksum
        val ipChecksum = computeChecksum(ipPacket, 0, 20)
        ipPacket[10] = ((ipChecksum shr 8) and 0xFF).toByte()
        ipPacket[11] = (ipChecksum and 0xFF).toByte()

        // UDP Header
        val udpLen = 8 + udpPayload.size
        ipPacket[20] = ((newSrcPort shr 8) and 0xFF).toByte()
        ipPacket[21] = (newSrcPort and 0xFF).toByte()
        ipPacket[22] = ((newDstPort shr 8) and 0xFF).toByte()
        ipPacket[23] = (newDstPort and 0xFF).toByte()
        ipPacket[24] = ((udpLen shr 8) and 0xFF).toByte()
        ipPacket[25] = (udpLen and 0xFF).toByte()
        ipPacket[26] = 0x00.toByte() // Checksum 0 = disabled for UDP IPv4
        ipPacket[27] = 0x00.toByte()

        // Payload
        System.arraycopy(udpPayload, 0, ipPacket, 28, udpPayload.size)
        return ipPacket
    }

    private fun computeChecksum(buf: ByteArray, offset: Int, length: Int): Int {
        var sum = 0
        var i = 0
        while (i < length) {
            val high = (buf[offset + i].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 8
            val low = if (i + 1 < length) (buf[offset + i + 1].toInt() and 0xFF) else 0
            sum += (high or low)
            i += 2
        }
        while ((sum shr 16) > 0) {
            sum = (sum and 0xFFFF) + (sum shr 16)
        }
        return sum.inv() and 0xFFFF
    }

    private fun buildUdpIp6Packet(
        origPacket: ByteArray,
        newSrcPort: Int,
        newDstPort: Int,
        udpPayload: ByteArray
    ): ByteArray {
        val udpLen = 8 + udpPayload.size
        val totalLen = 40 + udpLen
        val ipPacket = ByteArray(totalLen)

        // IPv6 Header (40 bytes)
        ipPacket[0] = 0x60.toByte() // Version 6, Traffic Class high = 0
        ipPacket[1] = 0x00.toByte() // Traffic Class low = 0, Flow Label high = 0
        ipPacket[2] = 0x00.toByte() // Flow label mid
        ipPacket[3] = 0x00.toByte() // Flow label low
        ipPacket[4] = ((udpLen shr 8) and 0xFF).toByte() // Payload length
        ipPacket[5] = (udpLen and 0xFF).toByte()
        ipPacket[6] = 17.toByte()   // Next Header: UDP (17)
        ipPacket[7] = 64.toByte()   // Hop Limit

        val newSrcIp = ByteArray(16)
        val newDstIp = ByteArray(16)
        System.arraycopy(origPacket, 24, newSrcIp, 0, 16) // new src = orig dst
        System.arraycopy(origPacket, 8, newDstIp, 0, 16)  // new dst = orig src

        System.arraycopy(newSrcIp, 0, ipPacket, 8, 16)
        System.arraycopy(newDstIp, 0, ipPacket, 24, 16)

        // UDP Header
        ipPacket[40] = ((newSrcPort shr 8) and 0xFF).toByte()
        ipPacket[41] = (newSrcPort and 0xFF).toByte()
        ipPacket[42] = ((newDstPort shr 8) and 0xFF).toByte()
        ipPacket[43] = (newDstPort and 0xFF).toByte()
        ipPacket[44] = ((udpLen shr 8) and 0xFF).toByte()
        ipPacket[45] = (udpLen and 0xFF).toByte()

        // Checksum (RFC 2460 / RFC 8200 mandatory for IPv6 UDP)
        val checksum = computeUdpIpv6Checksum(newSrcIp, newDstIp, udpPayload, newSrcPort, newDstPort)
        ipPacket[46] = ((checksum shr 8) and 0xFF).toByte()
        ipPacket[47] = (checksum and 0xFF).toByte()

        // Payload
        System.arraycopy(udpPayload, 0, ipPacket, 48, udpPayload.size)
        return ipPacket
    }

    private fun computeUdpIpv6Checksum(
        srcIp: ByteArray,
        dstIp: ByteArray,
        udpPayload: ByteArray,
        srcPort: Int,
        dstPort: Int
    ): Int {
        val udpLen = 8 + udpPayload.size
        var sum = 0L

        // 1. Source IPv6 Address (16 bytes = 8 16-bit words)
        var i = 0
        while (i < 16) {
            sum += ((srcIp[i].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 8) or (srcIp[i + 1].toInt() and 0xFF)
            i += 2
        }

        // 2. Destination IPv6 Address (16 bytes = 8 16-bit words)
        i = 0
        while (i < 16) {
            sum += ((dstIp[i].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 8) or (dstIp[i + 1].toInt() and 0xFF)
            i += 2
        }

        // 3. UDP Length (32 bits in IPv6 pseudo header)
        sum += (udpLen shr 16) and 0xFFFF
        sum += udpLen and 0xFFFF

        // 4. Next Header (Upper layer protocol = 17)
        sum += 17L

        // 5. UDP Source & Destination Ports
        sum += srcPort.toLong()
        sum += dstPort.toLong()

        // 6. UDP Length
        sum += udpLen.toLong()

        // 7. Payload
        i = 0
        while (i < udpPayload.size) {
            val high = (udpPayload[i].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 8
            val low = if (i + 1 < udpPayload.size) (udpPayload[i + 1].toInt() and 0xFF) else 0
            sum += (high or low).toLong()
            i += 2
        }

        // Fold 32-bit sum to 16 bits
        while ((sum shr 16) > 0) {
            sum = (sum and 0xFFFFL) + (sum shr 16)
        }

        val checksum = (sum.inv() and 0xFFFFL).toInt()
        return if (checksum == 0) 0xFFFF else checksum
    }

    private fun createNotificationChannel() {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
            val channel = NotificationChannel(
                CHANNEL_ID,
                "QIEZKA Web Guard",
                NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_LOW
            ).apply {
                description = "Active DNS sinkhole protecting focus sessions"
            }
            val nm = getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as? NotificationManager
            nm?.createNotificationChannel(channel)
        }
    }

    private fun buildNotification(): Notification {
        val builder = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
            Notification.Builder(this, CHANNEL_ID)
        } else {
            @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
            Notification.Builder(this)
        }

        return builder
            .setContentTitle("QIEZKA Web Guard Active")
            .setContentText("WebClassifier On-Device Protection Active")
            .setSmallIcon(R.mipmap.ic_launcher)
            .setOngoing(true)
            .build()
    }
}

        @JvmStatic
        fun isInOperatingHours(effectiveNow: Long): Boolean {
            val inst = instance
            if (inst != null && inst.prefs != null) {
                val mode = inst.prefs?.getString("operating_mode", "safemode")
                if ("hardcore".equals(mode, ignoreCase = true)) {
                    return true
                }
            }
            return isClockInOperatingHours(effectiveNow)
        }

        @JvmStatic
        private fun isClockInOperatingHours(effectiveNow: Long): Boolean {
            val cal = Calendar.getInstance()
            cal.timeInMillis = effectiveNow
            val hour = cal.get(Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY)
            val minute = cal.get(Calendar.MINUTE)
            val totalMins = hour * 60 + minute
            // Operating window: 19:00 (1140 mins) to 23:59 (1439 mins) OR 00:00 (0 mins) to 02:59 (179 mins)
            return (totalMins >= 1140 || totalMins < 180)
        }

        @JvmStatic
        fun hasActiveSchedules(preferences: SharedPreferences?): Boolean {
            if (preferences == null) return false
            val schedulesJson = preferences.getString("schedules_json", null)
            if (schedulesJson.isNullOrBlank()) return false
            if (schedulesJson.contains("\"isActive\":true") || schedulesJson.contains("\"isActive\": true")) {
                return true
            }
            try {
                val arr = JSONArray(schedulesJson)
                for (i in 0 until arr.length()) {
                    val s = arr.getJSONObject(i)
                    if (s.optBoolean("isActive", true)) {
                        return true
                    }
                }
            } catch (ignored: Exception) {}
            return false
        }

        private var sLastSirenCheckTime = 0L
        private var sCachedIsSirenDefault = false

        @JvmStatic
        fun isSirenDefaultLauncher(context: Context?): Boolean {
            val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
            if (sLastSirenCheckTime > now + 60000L) {
                return sCachedIsSirenDefault
            }
            if (context == null) return false
            if (now - sLastSirenCheckTime < 1000L) {
                return sCachedIsSirenDefault
            }
            try {
                // 1. Android 10+ (API 29+) RoleManager authoritative check via reflection
                if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q) {
                    try {
                        val roleManager = context.getSystemService(RoleManager::class.java)
                        if (roleManager != null && roleManager.isRoleAvailable(RoleManager.ROLE_HOME)) {
                            val method = roleManager.javaClass.getMethod("getRoleHolders", String::class.java)
                            @Suppress("UNCHECKED_CAST")
                            val holders = method.invoke(roleManager, RoleManager.ROLE_HOME) as? List<String>
                            if (!holders.isNullOrEmpty()) {
                                sCachedIsSirenDefault = holders.contains(LauncherStateManager.SIREN_PACKAGE)
                                sLastSirenCheckTime = now
                                return sCachedIsSirenDefault
                            }
                        }
                    } catch (ignore: Throwable) {}
                }

                // 2. Legacy PackageManager resolveActivity fallback
                val pm = context.packageManager
                if (pm != null) {
                    val homeIntent = Intent(Intent.ACTION_MAIN).apply {
                        addCategory(Intent.CATEGORY_HOME)
                    }
                    val defaultHome = pm.resolveActivity(homeIntent, PackageManager.MATCH_DEFAULT_ONLY)
                    if (defaultHome?.activityInfo != null) {
                        val pkg = defaultHome.activityInfo.packageName
                        if (pkg != null && pkg != "android") {
                            sCachedIsSirenDefault = LauncherStateManager.SIREN_PACKAGE == pkg
                            sLastSirenCheckTime = now
                            return sCachedIsSirenDefault
                        }
                    }
                    val resolvedHome = pm.resolveActivity(homeIntent, 0)
                    if (resolvedHome?.activityInfo != null) {
                        val pkg = resolvedHome.activityInfo.packageName
                        if (pkg != null && pkg != "android") {
                            sCachedIsSirenDefault = LauncherStateManager.SIREN_PACKAGE == pkg
                            sLastSirenCheckTime = now
                            return sCachedIsSirenDefault
                        }
                    }
                }
            } catch (ignore: Exception) {}
            sCachedIsSirenDefault = false
            sLastSirenCheckTime = now
            return false
        }

        @JvmStatic
        fun setCachedIsSirenDefaultForTesting(value: Boolean?) {
            if (value == null) {
                sLastSirenCheckTime = 0L
                sCachedIsSirenDefault = false
            } else {
                sCachedIsSirenDefault = value
                sLastSirenCheckTime = System.currentTimeMillis() + 3600000L
            }
        }

        @JvmStatic
        fun isSessionOrScheduleActive(context: Context?, preferences: SharedPreferences?): Boolean {
            if (preferences == null) return false
            val isLockdownActive = preferences.getBoolean("lockdown_active", false)
            val isConsequenceActive = preferences.getBoolean("consequence_active", false)

            val timeOffset = preferences.getLong("time_offset", preferences.getLong("simulated_time_offset", 0L))
            val effectiveNow = System.currentTimeMillis() + timeOffset
            val inOperatingHours = isClockInOperatingHours(effectiveNow)
            val isHardcore = "hardcore".equals(preferences.getString("operating_mode", "safemode"), ignoreCase = true)
            val isConsequenceEnforcing = isConsequenceActive && (isHardcore || inOperatingHours)

            val hasSchedules = hasActiveSchedules(preferences)
            return isLockdownActive || isConsequenceEnforcing || hasSchedules
        }

        @JvmStatic
        fun isBrowserNewTabPage(root: AccessibilityNodeInfo?): Boolean {

        @JvmStatic
        fun isValidUrlCandidate(valStr: String?): Boolean {
            if (valStr == null) return false
            val clean = valStr.trim()
            if (clean.isEmpty()) return false
            // Fast reject: Unencoded spaces indicate placeholder hint text or typed search queries
            if (clean.contains(" ")) return false
            // Fast reject: Common browser empty tab placeholder words without spaces
            val lower = clean.lowercase(Locale.US)
            if (lower == "search" || lower == "search..." ||
                lower == "about:blank" || lower.startsWith("chrome://newtab")) {
                return false
            }
            // Must look like a real host or URL: contains dot, or protocol, or path slash
            return clean.contains(".") || lower.startsWith("http://") || lower.startsWith("https://") || clean.contains("/")
        }

        @JvmStatic
        fun isLinkContextMenu(root: AccessibilityNodeInfo?, pkg: String?): Boolean {
            if (root == null) return false
            try {
                val resId = root.viewIdResourceName
                if (resId != null) {
                    val idStr = resId.toString()
                    if (idStr.endsWith(":id/context_menu_layout") || idStr.endsWith(":id/context_menu_frame") ||
                        idStr.endsWith(":id/context_menu_list_view") || idStr.endsWith(":id/menu_header_url") ||
                        idStr.endsWith(":id/menu_header_alt_text") || idStr.endsWith(":id/title_and_url") ||
                        idStr.endsWith(":id/context_menu_dialog") || idStr.endsWith(":id/link_context_menu") ||
                        idStr.endsWith(":id/mozac_browser_menu_list")) {
                        return true
                    }
                }

                if (pkg != null) {
                    val pkgIds = arrayOf(
                        "$pkg:id/context_menu_layout",
                        "$pkg:id/menu_header_url",
                        "$pkg:id/context_menu_frame",
                        "$pkg:id/context_menu_dialog",
                        "$pkg:id/link_context_menu"
                    )
                    for (pId in pkgIds) {
                        val nodes = root.findAccessibilityNodeInfosByViewId(pId)
                        if (!nodes.isNullOrEmpty()) {
                            recycleNodes(nodes)
                            return true
                        }
                    }
                }

                val chromeIds = arrayOf(
                    "com.android.chrome:id/context_menu_layout",
                    "com.android.chrome:id/menu_header_url",
                    "org.chromium.chrome:id/context_menu_layout",
                    "org.chromium.chrome:id/menu_header_url"
                )
                for (cId in chromeIds) {
                    val nodes = root.findAccessibilityNodeInfosByViewId(cId)
                    if (!nodes.isNullOrEmpty()) {
                        recycleNodes(nodes)
                        return true
                    }
                }

                // Universal semantic action check for search and browser link menus
                var openNodes = root.findAccessibilityNodeInfosByText("Open in new tab")
                if (openNodes.isNullOrEmpty()) {
                    openNodes = root.findAccessibilityNodeInfosByText("Open in browser")
                }
                if (!openNodes.isNullOrEmpty()) {
                    recycleNodes(openNodes)
                    val actionTexts = arrayOf("Copy link address", "Copy link text", "Copy link", "Share link")
                    for (action in actionTexts) {
                        val actionNodes = root.findAccessibilityNodeInfosByText(action)
                        if (!actionNodes.isNullOrEmpty()) {
                            recycleNodes(actionNodes)
                            return true
                        }
                    }
                }
            } catch (ignore: Exception) {}
            return false
        }

        @JvmStatic
        fun isInstalledLauncherCandidate(text: String?): Boolean {
            if (text.isNullOrBlank()) return false
            if (dynamicLauncherLabels.isEmpty() && instance != null) {
                instance?.refreshDynamicExemptPackages()
            }
            val lower = text.trim().lowercase(Locale.US)
            for (label in dynamicLauncherLabels) {
                if (label.isNotEmpty() && (lower == label || lower.contains(label) || label.contains(lower))) {
                    return true
                }
            }
            for (pkg in dynamicLauncherPackages) {
                if (pkg.isNotEmpty() && lower.contains(pkg.lowercase(Locale.US))) {
                    return true
                }
            }
            return lower.contains("launcher") || lower.contains("lawnchair") || lower.contains("trebuchet") ||
                   lower.contains("pixel launcher") || lower.contains("one ui") || lower.contains("homeproxy")
        }

        @JvmStatic
        fun isHomeAppSelectionTitle(title: String?): Boolean {
            if (title == null) return false
            val lower = title.trim().lowercase(Locale.US)
            // 1. Activity class name signatures (100% language-independent)
            if (lower.contains("requestroleactivity") || lower.contains("defaultappactivity") ||
                lower.contains("homesettingsactivity") || lower.contains("defaulthomepicker") ||
                lower.contains("rolesearchactivity") || lower.contains("specialappaccessactivity")) {
                return true
            }
            // 2. Generic home role tokens
            return lower.contains("default home") || lower.contains("home app") ||
                   (lower.contains("default") && lower.contains("home")) ||
                   lower == "home launcher"
        }

        private fun recycleNodes(nodes: List<AccessibilityNodeInfo?>?) {
            if (nodes != null) {
                for (n in nodes) {
                    if (n != null) {
                        try { n.recycle() } catch (ignore: Exception) {}
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        @JvmStatic
        fun findRootNode(node: AccessibilityNodeInfo?): AccessibilityNodeInfo? {
            if (node == null) return null
            var curr: AccessibilityNodeInfo = node
            while (true) {
                val parent = curr.parent ?: break
                if (curr != node) {
                    try { curr.recycle() } catch (ignore: Exception) {}
                }
                curr = parent
            }
            return curr
        }

        @JvmStatic
        fun countInstalledLauncherCandidates(node: AccessibilityNodeInfo?, maxDepth: Int = 8): Int {
            if (node == null || maxDepth < 0) return 0
            var count = 0
            try {
                val txt = node.text
                if (txt != null && isInstalledLauncherCandidate(txt.toString())) {
                    count++
                } else {
                    val desc = node.contentDescription
                    if (desc != null && isInstalledLauncherCandidate(desc.toString())) {
                        count++
                    }
                }
                if (count >= 2) return count

                val childCount = node.childCount
                for (i in 0 until childCount) {
                    val child = node.getChild(i)
                    if (child != null) {
                        try {
                            count += countInstalledLauncherCandidates(child, maxDepth - 1)
                            if (count >= 2) return count
                        } finally {
                            child.recycle()
                        }
                    }
                }
            } catch (ignore: Exception) {}
            return count
        }

        @JvmStatic
        fun isHomeAppSelectionPackageOrRoot(context: Context?, pkg: String?, root: AccessibilityNodeInfo?): Boolean {
            if (pkg == null || root == null) return false
            val rootPkg = root.packageName?.toString()?.lowercase(Locale.US) ?: ""
            val lower = if (rootPkg.isNotEmpty() && rootPkg != "android") rootPkg else pkg.lowercase(Locale.US)
            val myPkg = context?.packageName ?: "com.uncode.app"
            if (lower == myPkg || lower == "com.android.systemui" || lower == "com.siren.homeproxy") {
                return false
            }

            try {
                // 1. Check exact activity class name on root if available (language-independent)
                val rootClass = root.className
                if (rootClass != null) {
                    val rc = rootClass.toString().lowercase(Locale.US)
                    if (rc.contains("requestroleactivity") || rc.contains("defaultappactivity") ||
                        rc.contains("homesettingsactivity") || rc.contains("defaulthomepicker") ||
                        rc.contains("rolesearchactivity") || rc.contains("resolveractivity")) {
                        return true
                    }
                }

                // 2. Normal launcher desktop / app drawer is 100% immune:
                val btn1 = root.findAccessibilityNodeInfosByViewId("android:id/button1")
                val btn2 = root.findAccessibilityNodeInfosByViewId("android:id/button2")
                val dontAsk = root.findAccessibilityNodeInfosByViewId("com.android.permissioncontroller:id/dont_ask_again")
                val hasDialogControls = !btn1.isNullOrEmpty() || !btn2.isNullOrEmpty() || !dontAsk.isNullOrEmpty()
                recycleNodes(btn1)
                recycleNodes(btn2)
                recycleNodes(dontAsk)

                if (isLauncherApp(context, lower) && !hasDialogControls) {
                    return false
                }

                // 3. PermissionController Role UI: id/list containing candidate launcher items, or dont_ask_again checkbox
                if (lower.contains("permissioncontroller") || rootPkg.contains("permissioncontroller")) {
                    val listNodes = root.findAccessibilityNodeInfosByViewId("com.android.permissioncontroller:id/list")
                    if (!listNodes.isNullOrEmpty()) {
                        recycleNodes(listNodes)
                        val launcherCount = countInstalledLauncherCandidates(root)
                        if (launcherCount >= 1) {
                            return true
                        }
                        val dontAskNodes = root.findAccessibilityNodeInfosByViewId("com.android.permissioncontroller:id/dont_ask_again")
                        if (!dontAskNodes.isNullOrEmpty()) {
                            recycleNodes(dontAskNodes)
                            return true
                        }
                    }
                    val dontAskNodes = root.findAccessibilityNodeInfosByViewId("com.android.permissioncontroller:id/dont_ask_again")
                    if (!dontAskNodes.isNullOrEmpty()) {
                        recycleNodes(dontAskNodes)
                        return true
                    }
                }

                // 4. Settings Default Home Picker UI:
                if (lower.contains("settings") || rootPkg.contains("settings")) {
                    val launcherCount = countInstalledLauncherCandidates(root)
                    if (launcherCount >= 2) {
                        return true
                    }
                }

                // 5. Modal Dialogs with candidate items & dialog confirmation controls
                if (hasDialogControls) {
                    val launcherCount = countInstalledLauncherCandidates(root)
                    if (launcherCount >= 1) {
                        return true
                    }
                }

                // 6. Check title text in permissioncontroller role UI or Settings
                val titleNodes = root.findAccessibilityNodeInfosByViewId("com.android.permissioncontroller:id/title")
                if (!titleNodes.isNullOrEmpty()) {
                    for (t in titleNodes) {
                        val txt = t.text
                        if (txt != null && (isHomeAppSelectionTitle(txt.toString()) || isInstalledLauncherCandidate(txt.toString()))) {
                            recycleNodes(titleNodes)
                            return true
                        }
                    }
                    recycleNodes(titleNodes)
                }
            } catch (ignore: Exception) {}
            return false
        }

        private fun extractHost(rawUrl: String?): String {
            if (rawUrl == null) return ""
            var clean = rawUrl.trim().lowercase(Locale.US)
            if (clean.startsWith("https://")) clean = clean.substring(8)
            else if (clean.startsWith("http://")) clean = clean.substring(7)
            val slash = clean.indexOf('/')
            if (slash != -1) clean = clean.substring(0, slash)
            val colon = clean.indexOf(':')
            if (colon != -1) clean = clean.substring(0, colon)
            if (clean.startsWith("www.")) clean = clean.substring(4)
            return clean
        }

        private fun isSearchEngineHost(host: String?): Boolean {
            if (host.isNullOrEmpty()) return false
            if (host == "gemini.google.com" || host == "bard.google.com") {
                return false // Gemini and Bard are conversational AI assistants, NOT search engines!
            }
            if (host == "google.com" || host == "www.google.com") {
                return true
            }
            if ((host.startsWith("google.") || host.startsWith("www.google.")) && !host.contains("gemini") && !host.contains("bard")) {
                return true
            }
            return host == "bing.com" || host == "www.bing.com" ||
                   host == "duckduckgo.com" || host == "www.duckduckgo.com" ||
                   host == "search.yahoo.com" || host == "ecosia.org" || host == "www.ecosia.org" ||
                   host == "qwant.com" || host == "www.qwant.com" ||
                   host == "baidu.com" || host == "www.baidu.com" || host == "m.baidu.com" || host.endsWith(".baidu.com") ||
                   host == "naver.com" || host == "www.naver.com" || host == "m.naver.com" || host.endsWith(".naver.com") ||
                   host == "yandex.com" || host == "www.yandex.com" ||
                   host == "startpage.com" || host == "www.startpage.com"
        }
    }

    fun startTicker() {
        tickerHandler.removeCallbacks(tickerRunnable)
        tickerHandler.post(tickerRunnable)
    }

    private fun runOnMain(r: Runnable) {
        if (Looper.myLooper() == Looper.getMainLooper()) {
            r.run()
        } else {
            mainHandler.post(r)
        }
    }

    private fun postBrowserAudit(targetPkg: String?) {
        postBrowserAudit(targetPkg, 0)
    }

    private fun postBrowserAudit(targetPkg: String?, pollStep: Int) {
        val handler = auditHandler ?: return
        if (targetPkg == null) return
        if (pollStep == 0) {
            handler.removeCallbacksAndMessages(auditStep0Token)
            handler.postAtTime({ executeBrowserAudit(targetPkg, 0) }, auditStep0Token, SystemClock.uptimeMillis())
        } else {
            val delay = if (pollStep - 1 < PROGRESSIVE_DOM_POLL_DELAYS.size) {
                PROGRESSIVE_DOM_POLL_DELAYS[pollStep - 1]
            } else {
                1500L
            }
            handler.postDelayed({ executeBrowserAudit(targetPkg, pollStep) }, delay)
        }
    }

    private fun executeBrowserAudit(targetPkg: String, pollStep: Int) {
        try {
            val root = rootInActiveWindow
            if (root != null) {
                try {
                    val rPkg = root.packageName
                    if (rPkg != null && !isSystemOrLauncher(rPkg.toString())) {
                        val isSurface = isBrowserSurface(rPkg.toString(), lastActiveActivityClass, root)
                        if (isSurface) {
                            inspectBrowserWindow(root, targetPkg, false, pollStep)
                        }
                    }
                } finally {
                    root.recycle()
                }
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Error in background browser audit (step $pollStep): ${e.message}")
        }
    }

    override fun onCreate() {
        super.onCreate()
        instance = this
        prefs = getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        refreshDynamicExemptPackages()
        AppClassifier.refreshBrowserCache(this)

        val thread = HandlerThread("Qiezka-AuditWorker", Process.THREAD_PRIORITY_BACKGROUND)
        thread.start()
        auditThread = thread
        auditHandler = Handler(thread.looper)

        startTicker()
        Log.i(TAG, "LockAccessibilityService onCreate — ticker and audit worker started")
    }

    override fun onStartCommand(intent: Intent?, flags: Int, startId: Int): Int {
        startTicker()
        return START_STICKY
    }

    override fun onTaskRemoved(rootIntent: Intent?) {
        super.onTaskRemoved(rootIntent)
        Log.i(TAG, "onTaskRemoved: app task cleared from recents — keeping ticker alive")
        startTicker()
    }

    override fun onServiceConnected() {
        super.onServiceConnected()
        instance = this
        prefs = getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        AppClassifier.refreshBrowserCache(this)

        var thread = auditThread
        if (thread == null || !thread.isAlive) {
            thread = HandlerThread("Qiezka-AuditWorker", Process.THREAD_PRIORITY_BACKGROUND)
            thread.start()
            auditThread = thread
            auditHandler = Handler(thread.looper)
        }

        val info = AccessibilityServiceInfo().apply {
            packageNames = null // Watch all packages
            eventTypes = AccessibilityEvent.TYPE_WINDOW_STATE_CHANGED or
                    AccessibilityEvent.TYPE_WINDOWS_CHANGED or
                    AccessibilityEvent.TYPE_WINDOW_CONTENT_CHANGED or
                    AccessibilityEvent.TYPE_VIEW_CLICKED or
                    AccessibilityEvent.TYPE_VIEW_FOCUSED
            feedbackType = AccessibilityServiceInfo.FEEDBACK_GENERIC
            flags = AccessibilityServiceInfo.FLAG_REPORT_VIEW_IDS or
                    AccessibilityServiceInfo.FLAG_RETRIEVE_INTERACTIVE_WINDOWS or
                    AccessibilityServiceInfo.FLAG_INCLUDE_NOT_IMPORTANT_VIEWS
            notificationTimeout = 0
        }
        serviceInfo = info

        refreshDynamicExemptPackages()
        startTicker()

        // Immediate evaluation on reconnect
        try {
            val p = prefs
            var active = p?.getBoolean("lockdown_active", false) ?: false
            if (!active && p != null) {
                active = checkAndAutoStartScheduledLock(p)
            }
            if (active) {
                val lockEnd = p?.getLong("lock_end_time", 0L) ?: 0L
                FloatingOverlayService.startService(this, lockEnd, "Study Session")
                val activePkg = detectCurrentForegroundPackage()
                if (activePkg != null && isPackageBlocked(activePkg)) {
                    enforceBlock(activePkg)
                }
            }
        } catch (ignore: Exception) {}

        Log.i(TAG, "LockAccessibilityService connected and ticker running")
    }

    override fun onDestroy() {
        super.onDestroy()
        instance = null
        auditThread?.let {
            it.quitSafely()
            auditThread = null
            auditHandler = null
        }
        tickerHandler.removeCallbacks(tickerRunnable)
        Log.i(TAG, "LockAccessibilityService onDestroy")
    }

    private fun refreshDynamicExemptPackages() {
        try {
            val pm = packageManager ?: return

            // Dynamically discover all installed Home Launchers (CATEGORY_HOME)
            try {
                val homeIntent = Intent(Intent.ACTION_MAIN).apply {
                    addCategory(Intent.CATEGORY_HOME)
                }
                val homeApps = pm.queryIntentActivities(homeIntent, 0)
                if (homeApps != null) {
                    for (info in homeApps) {
                        if (InstalledLauncherDetector.isRealLauncher(info, packageName)) {
                            info.activityInfo?.packageName?.let { dynamicLauncherPackages.add(it) }
                            val lbl = info.loadLabel(pm)
                            if (lbl != null) {
                                dynamicLauncherLabels.add(lbl.toString().trim().lowercase(Locale.US))
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            } catch (ignore: Exception) {}

            Log.d(TAG, "Discovered dynamic launchers: ${dynamicLauncherPackages.size}")
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.w(TAG, "Error resolving dynamic launchers: ${e.message}")
        }
    }

    private fun isKeyboardApp(pkg: String?): Boolean {
        if (pkg == null) return false
        return KnownSafe.isKeyboardPackage(this, pkg)
    }

    fun hasActiveSchedules(): Boolean {
        if (prefs == null) {
            prefs = getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        }
        return hasActiveSchedules(prefs)
    }

    fun isHomeChangeInterceptorActive(): Boolean {
        if (prefs == null) {
            prefs = getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        }
        return isHomeChangeInterceptorActive(this, prefs)
    }

    override fun onAccessibilityEvent(event: AccessibilityEvent?) {
        if (event == null) return

        if (prefs == null) {
            prefs = getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        }

        // ── Authoritative Truth Table Gate (Evaluates Home Role surfaces instantly) ──
        val src = event.source
        var root = if (src != null) findRootNode(src) else null
        var rootNeedsRecycle = (root != null && root != src)
        if (root == null) {
            root = rootInActiveWindow
            if (root != null) rootNeedsRecycle = true
        }

        val topPkgChar = event.packageName
        val topPkgStr = topPkgChar?.toString()
        val topEventCls = event.className?.toString()
        val candidateCls = if (isLikelyActivityClass(topEventCls)) topEventCls else lastActiveActivityClass

        try {
            val decision = HomeRoleTruthTable.evaluate(this, event, root, topPkgStr, candidateCls, prefs)
            when (decision) {
                HomeRoleTruthTable.Decision.INTERCEPT -> {
                    // State 1: SIREN is default + Active session -> Evict evasion attempt
                    evictHomeLauncherChange(root)
                    return
                }
                HomeRoleTruthTable.Decision.ALLOW -> {
                    // States 2, 3, 4: Permitted Home Role surface -> Allow completely, bypass Stage 1 Master Veto
                    return
                }
                HomeRoleTruthTable.Decision.NOT_HOME_ROLE -> {
                    // Not a home role surface, proceed to standard event processing
                }
            }
        } finally {
            if (rootNeedsRecycle) {
                try { root?.recycle() } catch (ignore: Exception) {}
            }
            try { src?.recycle() } catch (ignore: Exception) {}
        }

        // Track foreground app switches
        val eventType = event.eventType

        // User Mandate: Scroll events must NEVER trigger inspections, DOM crawls, or app blocks
        if (eventType == AccessibilityEvent.TYPE_VIEW_SCROLLED) {
            return
        }

        // Flowchart Immunity: Long press gestures and in-page selections must NEVER trigger app blocks or evictions
        if (eventType == AccessibilityEvent.TYPE_VIEW_LONG_CLICKED) {
            return
        }

        if (event.className != null) {
            val clsStr = event.className.toString()
            lastBrowserEventClass = clsStr
            if (eventType == AccessibilityEvent.TYPE_WINDOW_STATE_CHANGED && isLikelyActivityClass(clsStr)) {
                lastActiveActivityClass = clsStr
            }
        }

        val pkgChar = event.packageName
        if (pkgChar != null) {
            val pkgStr = pkgChar.toString()
            val eventCls = event.className?.toString()
            var activeCls = if (isLikelyActivityClass(eventCls)) eventCls else lastActiveActivityClass
            activeCls = resolveCandidateClass(pkgStr, activeCls, event.source)
            if (AppClassifier.isSystemSettingsDialog(activeCls)) {
                lastActiveActivityClass = activeCls
            }
            if (eventType == AccessibilityEvent.TYPE_WINDOW_STATE_CHANGED ||
                eventType == AccessibilityEvent.TYPE_WINDOWS_CHANGED ||
                eventType == AccessibilityEvent.TYPE_VIEW_FOCUSED) {
                if (isGeminiActive(pkgStr, eventCls, event.source) && !isGeminiAllowed()) {
                    lastForegroundPackage = "com.google.android.apps.bard"
                } else if (isLauncherApp(this, pkgStr)) {
                    // Navigated to Home/Launcher: update lastForegroundPackage to launcher so background browsers are not remembered as active
                    lastForegroundPackage = pkgStr
                } else if (!isSystemOrLauncher(pkgStr, activeCls)) {
                    lastForegroundPackage = pkgStr
                }
            }
        }

        val currentPrefs = prefs ?: getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE).also { prefs = it }
        var isLockdownActive = currentPrefs.getBoolean("lockdown_active", false)
        var isConsequenceActive = currentPrefs.getBoolean("consequence_active", false)
        val lockEndTime = currentPrefs.getLong("lock_end_time", 0L)
        val timeOffset = currentPrefs.getLong("time_offset", 0L)
        val effectiveNow = System.currentTimeMillis() + timeOffset

        val inOperatingHours = isInOperatingHours(effectiveNow)

        // ── Native Timestamp Handling on Timer Expiration ──
        if (isLockdownActive && !isConsequenceActive && lockEndTime > 0 && effectiveNow >= lockEndTime) {
            isConsequenceActive = true
            currentPrefs.edit()
                .putBoolean("consequence_active", true)
                .remove("lock_end_time")
                .apply()
            AlarmReceiver.cancelLockEndAlarm(this)
            AlarmReceiver.createNotificationChannels(this)
            val isHardcore = "hardcore".equals(currentPrefs.getString("operating_mode", "safemode"), ignoreCase = true)
            val notifTitle = if (isHardcore) {
                "⚠️ Homework Expired — Consequence Active (Hardcore)"
            } else {
                "⚠️ Homework Expired — Consequence Active"
            }
            val notifMsg = if (isHardcore) {
                "Study timer expired without passing. Distracting apps remain restricted 24/7 (Hardcore Mode) until rescheduled and passed."
            } else {
                "Study timer expired without passing. Distracting apps remain restricted during operating hours (7 PM – 3 AM) until rescheduled and passed."
            }
            AlarmReceiver.showNotificationStatic(
                this,
                AlarmReceiver.NOTIF_ID_COMPLETED,
                AlarmReceiver.CHANNEL_ID_ALERTS,
                notifTitle,
                notifMsg,
                Notification.PRIORITY_HIGH,
                false
            )
            val nm = getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as? NotificationManager
            nm?.cancel(AlarmReceiver.NOTIF_ID_STATUS)
            Log.i(TAG, "Lockdown expired — entered Consequence Mode")
        }

        // ── State Evaluation: Lockdown, Consequence, Standby, or Total Idle ──
        val isHardcore = "hardcore".equals(currentPrefs.getString("operating_mode", "safemode"), ignoreCase = true)
        val isConsequenceEnforcing = isConsequenceActive && (isHardcore || inOperatingHours)

        if (!isLockdownActive && !isConsequenceActive) {
            isLockdownActive = checkAndAutoStartScheduledLock(currentPrefs)
        }

        val isEnforcing = isLockdownActive || isConsequenceEnforcing
        val hasSchedules = hasActiveSchedules()

        // Flowchart: If Consequence Active in Safemode outside Operating Hours (Daytime 3am-7pm) -> ALLOW_IDLE
        if (isConsequenceActive && !isHardcore && !inOperatingHours) {
            return
        }

        // Flowchart: If neither Lockdown nor Consequence is Active, check Active Schedules
        if (!isEnforcing && !hasSchedules) {
            // Total System Idle: Zero schedules -> ALLOW_IDLE (Settings, launcher, and uninstall allowed)
            return
        }

        // ── STAGE 1: MASTER VETO GATE (Active Lockdown, Active Consequence, or Standby Protection) ──
        if (pkgChar != null) {
            val pkgStr = pkgChar.toString()
            val eventCls = event.className?.toString()
            var activeCls = if (isLikelyActivityClass(eventCls)) eventCls else lastActiveActivityClass
            activeCls = resolveCandidateClass(pkgStr, activeCls, event.source)
            if (AppClassifier.isSystemSettingsDialog(activeCls)) {
                lastActiveActivityClass = activeCls
            }

            if (pkgStr != packageName && !isSystemOrLauncher(pkgStr, activeCls)) {
                // Secondary Authoritative Truth Table Gate check
                val homeDecision = HomeRoleTruthTable.evaluate(this, event, null, pkgStr, activeCls, currentPrefs)
                if (homeDecision == HomeRoleTruthTable.Decision.ALLOW) {
                    return
                } else if (homeDecision == HomeRoleTruthTable.Decision.INTERCEPT) {
                    evictHomeLauncherChange(null)
                    return
                }

                var appLabel: String? = null
                try {
                    val pm = packageManager
                    if (pm != null) {
                        val ai = pm.getApplicationInfo(pkgStr, 0)
                        val lbl = pm.getApplicationLabel(ai)
                        if (lbl != null) appLabel = lbl.toString()
                    }
                } catch (ignore: Exception) {}

                if (AppClassifier.isSettingsOrDeviceManager(pkgStr, appLabel, activeCls) || AppClassifier.isStage1Bloat(pkgStr, appLabel)) {
                    Log.w(TAG, "Stage 1 Master Veto Gate matched: $pkgStr ($appLabel, $activeCls)")
                    enforceBlock(pkgStr)
                    return
