                            true
                        )
                        isLockdownActive = true
                        FloatingOverlayService.startService(this, windowEnd, s.optString("title", "Study Session"))

                        // Immediately kick out if user is currently inside a blocked app
                        val activePkg = detectCurrentForegroundPackage()
                        if (activePkg != null && isPackageBlocked(activePkg)) {
                            enforceBlock(activePkg)
                        }
                    }

                    // B) Check advance countdown warnings before schedule start
                    val diffSec = (schedStartTime - effectiveNow) / 1000L
                    if (diffSec in 1..1800) {
                        checkAndFireTickerWarning(s.optString("id", ""), diffSec)
                    }
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Ticker schedule check error: ${e.message}")
            }
        }

        // 3. State Evaluation Gate
        isHardcore = "hardcore".equals(currentPrefs.getString("operating_mode", "safemode"), ignoreCase = true)
        isConsequenceEnforcing = isConsequenceActive && (isHardcore || inOperatingHours)
        isEnforcing = isLockdownActive || isConsequenceEnforcing
        val hasSchedules = hasActiveSchedules()

        if (isConsequenceActive && !isHardcore && !inOperatingHours) {
            return // Safemode Daytime (3am - 7pm): ALLOW_IDLE
        }

        if (!isEnforcing && !hasSchedules) {
            return // Total System Idle: ALLOW_IDLE
        }

        // ── STAGE 1: Anti-Tamper & Task Killer Shield (Active Lockdown, Consequence, or Standby) ──
        val activeRoot = rootInActiveWindow
        if (activeRoot != null) {
            try {
                val p = activeRoot.packageName
                if (p != null) {
                    val rootPkg = p.toString()
                    if (rootPkg != packageName) {
                        val activeCls = resolveCandidateClass(rootPkg, lastActiveActivityClass, activeRoot)
                        if (AppClassifier.isSystemSettingsDialog(activeCls)) {
                            lastActiveActivityClass = activeCls
                        }

                        // Authoritative Truth Table Gate
                        val homeDecision = HomeRoleTruthTable.evaluate(this, null, activeRoot, rootPkg, activeCls, currentPrefs)
                        if (homeDecision == HomeRoleTruthTable.Decision.INTERCEPT) {
                            evictHomeLauncherChange(activeRoot)
                            return
                        } else if (homeDecision == HomeRoleTruthTable.Decision.ALLOW) {
                            return
                        }

                        var appLabel: String? = null
                        try {
                            val pm = packageManager
                            if (pm != null) {
                                val ai = pm.getApplicationInfo(rootPkg, 0)
                                val lbl = pm.getApplicationLabel(ai)
                                if (lbl != null) appLabel = lbl.toString()
                            }
                        } catch (ignore: Exception) {}

                        if (isSystemOrLauncher(rootPkg, activeCls)) {
                            // System or launcher allowed
                        } else if (AppClassifier.isSettingsOrDeviceManager(rootPkg, appLabel, activeCls) || AppClassifier.isStage1Bloat(rootPkg, appLabel)) {
                            enforceBlock(rootPkg)
                            return
                        }

                        // STAGE 2 & 3: Only when Lockdown or Consequence is Active
                        if (isEnforcing) {
                            auditAndRemediatePictureInPicture()
                            if (isGeminiActive(rootPkg, null, activeRoot) && !isGeminiAllowed()) {
                                Log.w(TAG, "Ticker: detected Gemini active in foreground while AI policy is disabled")
                                enforceBlock("com.google.android.apps.bard")
                                return
                            }
                            if (!isSystemOrLauncher(rootPkg, activeCls)) {
                                if (isBrowserSurface(rootPkg, activeCls, activeRoot)) {
                                    postBrowserAudit(rootPkg)
                                } else if (isPackageBlocked(rootPkg, activeCls)) {
                                    enforceBlock(rootPkg)
                                    return
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            } finally {
                activeRoot.recycle()
            }
        } else {
            // Fallback: When getRootInActiveWindow() is null (e.g. system transitions / secure surfaces)
            if (!isEnforcing) {
                return // Standby: normal apps allowed
            }

            auditAndRemediatePictureInPicture()

            val currentForegroundPkg = detectCurrentForegroundPackage()
            if (currentForegroundPkg != null && !isSystemOrLauncher(currentForegroundPkg) && currentForegroundPkg != packageName) {
                if (isBrowserSurface(currentForegroundPkg, lastActiveActivityClass)) {
                    postBrowserAudit(currentForegroundPkg)
                } else if (isPackageBlocked(currentForegroundPkg)) {
                    enforceBlock(currentForegroundPkg)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun checkAndFireTickerWarning(schedId: String, diffSec: Long) {
        var warnKey: String? = null
        var warnText: String? = null

        if (diffSec in 1795..1800) {
            warnKey = "${schedId}_30m"
            warnText = "⏰ Upcoming study session in 30 minutes! Wrap up your tasks."
        } else if (diffSec in 895..900) {
            warnKey = "${schedId}_15m"
            warnText = "⏰ Study session starts in 15 minutes! Prepare your materials."
        } else if (diffSec in 295..300) {
            warnKey = "${schedId}_5m"
            warnText = "⚠️ Lockdown in 5 minutes! Save your work on other apps."
        } else if (diffSec in 55..60) {
            warnKey = "${schedId}_1m"
            warnText = "⚠️ Lockdown in 1 minute! QIEZKA is preparing to lock."
        } else if (diffSec in 25..30) {
            warnKey = "${schedId}_30s"
            warnText = "🚨 Lockdown starting in 30 seconds! QIEZKA is engaging."
        } else if (diffSec in 5..10) {
            warnKey = "${schedId}_10s"
            warnText = "🚨 Lockdown starting in 10 seconds!"
        }

        if (warnKey != null && warnText != null && !firedWarningKeys.contains(warnKey)) {
            firedWarningKeys.add(warnKey)
            Log.i(TAG, "Firing ticker advance warning: $warnText")
            AlarmReceiver.showNotificationStatic(
                this,
                AlarmReceiver.NOTIF_ID_WARNING,
                AlarmReceiver.CHANNEL_ID_ALERTS,
                "⏰ QIEZKA Upcoming Lockdown",
                warnText,
                Notification.PRIORITY_HIGH,
                false
            )
        }
    }

    private fun checkAndFireLockdownTimerWarning(remSec: Long) {
        var warnKey: String? = null
        var warnText: String? = null

        if (remSec in 1795..1800) {
            warnKey = "lock_timer_30m"
            warnText = "⏳ 30 minutes remaining in active lockdown."
        } else if (remSec in 895..900) {
            warnKey = "lock_timer_15m"
            warnText = "⏳ 15 minutes remaining in active lockdown."
        } else if (remSec in 295..300) {
            warnKey = "lock_timer_5m"
            warnText = "⏳ 5 minutes remaining! Finish your homework submission."
        } else if (remSec in 55..60) {
            warnKey = "lock_timer_1m"
            warnText = "⏳ 1 minute remaining before lockdown auto-unlocks."
        } else if (remSec in 25..30) {
            warnKey = "lock_timer_30s"
            warnText = "⏳ 30 seconds remaining!"
        }

        if (warnKey != null && warnText != null && !firedWarningKeys.contains(warnKey)) {
            firedWarningKeys.add(warnKey)
            Log.i(TAG, "Firing lockdown timer warning: $warnText")
            AlarmReceiver.showNotificationStatic(
                this,
                AlarmReceiver.NOTIF_ID_WARNING,
                AlarmReceiver.CHANNEL_ID_ALERTS,
                "⏳ QIEZKA Lock Timer",
                warnText,
                Notification.PRIORITY_HIGH,
                false
            )
        }
    }

    fun enforceBlock(pkg: String?) {
        if (pkg == null || pkg == packageName || isSystemOrLauncher(pkg)) {
            return
        }
        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
        if (now - lastBlockTimestamp < 350L && pkg == lastBlockedPackage) {
            return // Debounce rapid accessibility events from the same launch attempt
        }
        lastBlockTimestamp = now
        lastBlockedPackage = pkg

        Log.w(TAG, "enforceBlock on distracting app: $pkg — directly bringing QIEZKA lock to front (no home redirection, no back press)")

        // Directly bring QIEZKA lock screen to front immediately (no synthetic back press)
        launchLockOverlay()

        // Follow-up burst check to re-assert QIEZKA Lock overlay if another activity transitions in
        tickerHandler.postDelayed({
            val fg = detectCurrentForegroundPackage()
            if (fg != null && fg != packageName && !isSystemOrLauncher(fg)) {
                if (isPackageBlocked(fg)) {
                    launchLockOverlay()
                }
            }
        }, 100L)

        tickerHandler.postDelayed({
            val fg = detectCurrentForegroundPackage()
            if (fg != null && fg != packageName && !isSystemOrLauncher(fg)) {
                if (isPackageBlocked(fg)) {
                    launchLockOverlay()
                }
            }
        }, 250L)
    }

    fun auditAndRemediatePictureInPicture() {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
            return
        }
        try {
            val winList = windows
            if (winList.isNullOrEmpty()) return

            for (w in winList) {
                if (w != null && w.isInPictureInPictureMode) {
                    val root = w.root
                    if (root != null) {
                        try {
                            val p = root.packageName
                            if (p != null) {
                                val pipPkg = p.toString()
                                if (pipPkg == packageName || isSystemOrLauncher(pipPkg)) {
                                    continue
                                }

                                val isPortal = AppClassifier.isPortalSuperApp(pipPkg)
                                val isBlocked = isPackageBlocked(pipPkg)
                                val isVideoRestricted = !isVideoPolicyAllowed()

                                if (isBlocked || (isPortal && isVideoRestricted) || (isVideoRestricted && isMediaAppOrPip(pipPkg))) {
                                    val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
                                    if (now - lastPipRemediationTime > 1200L) {
                                        lastPipRemediationTime = now
                                        Log.w(TAG, "🛡️ Unauthorized Picture-in-Picture / miniplayer overlay detected: $pipPkg -> Remediating")

                                        // 1. Standard Accessibility action to dismiss floating window
                                        try {
                                            root.performAction(AccessibilityNodeInfo.ACTION_DISMISS)
                                        } catch (ignore: Exception) {}

                                        // 2. Educational Toast notice (throttled)
                                        if (now - lastBrowserToastTime >= 4000L) {
                                            lastBrowserToastTime = now
                                            Handler(Looper.getMainLooper()).post {
                                                Toast.makeText(applicationContext,
                                                    "⚠️ Video miniplayer / Picture-in-Picture is restricted during focus lockdown.",
                                                    Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                                            }
                                        }

                                        // 3. For portal super-apps (like NAVER): bring search homepage to front, killing PiP task
                                        if (isPortal) {
                                            try {
                                                val homeIntent = packageManager?.getLaunchIntentForPackage(pipPkg)
                                                if (homeIntent != null) {
                                                    homeIntent.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK or Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TOP or Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_SINGLE_TOP)
                                                    startActivity(homeIntent)
                                                }
                                            } catch (ignore: Exception) {}
                                        } else {
                                            // 4. For blocked apps (YouTube, Bilibili, Netflix, etc.): enforce lock overlay
                                            enforceBlock(pipPkg)
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        } finally {
                            root.recycle()
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "auditAndRemediatePictureInPicture error: ${e.message}")
        }
    }

    private fun isMediaAppOrPip(pkg: String?): Boolean {
        if (pkg == null) return false
        val lower = pkg.lowercase(Locale.US)
        return lower.contains("video") || lower.contains("media") || lower.contains("player") ||
               lower.contains("stream") || lower.contains("tube") || lower.contains("movie") ||
               lower.contains("bstar") || lower.contains("bilibili") || lower.contains("netflix") ||
               lower.contains("tiktok") || lower.contains("twitch") || lower.contains("nhn.android")
    }

    fun onScheduleStartTriggered() {
        try {
            val activePkg = detectCurrentForegroundPackage()
            if (activePkg != null && activePkg != packageName && isPackageBlocked(activePkg)) {
                enforceBlock(activePkg)
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "onScheduleStartTriggered error: ${e.message}")
        }
    }

    fun detectCurrentForegroundPackage(): String? {
        // 1. Z-Order Window Audit: Check if any active or visible application window belongs to a blocked package.
        try {
            val winList = windows
            if (!winList.isNullOrEmpty()) {
                for (w in winList) {
                    if (w.type == AccessibilityWindowInfo.TYPE_APPLICATION) {
                        val root = w.root
                        if (root != null) {
                            try {
                                val p = root.packageName
                                if (p != null) {
                                    val pkg = p.toString()
                                    val winTitle = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.P && w.title != null) w.title.toString() else null
                                    val candidateCls = resolveCandidateClass(pkg, if (!winTitle.isNullEmpty()) winTitle else lastActiveActivityClass, root)
                                    if (isSystemOrLauncher(pkg, candidateCls) || pkg == packageName || "com.android.systemui" == pkg) {
                                        // continue
                                    } else if ("com.google.android.googlequicksearchbox" == pkg && isGeminiActive(pkg, null, root) && !isGeminiAllowed()) {
                                        lastForegroundPackage = "com.google.android.apps.bard"
                                        return "com.google.android.apps.bard"
                                    } else if (!isSystemOrLauncher(pkg, candidateCls) && isPackageBlocked(pkg, candidateCls)) {
                                        lastForegroundPackage = pkg
                                        return pkg
                                    }
                                }
                            } finally {
                                root.recycle()
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (ignore: Exception) {}

        // 2. Primary: Inspect active root window directly
        try {
            val activeRoot = rootInActiveWindow
            if (activeRoot != null) {
                try {
                    val p = activeRoot.packageName
                    if (p != null) {
                        val rootPkg = p.toString()
                        if ("com.google.android.googlequicksearchbox" == rootPkg && isGeminiActive(rootPkg, null, null) && !isGeminiAllowed()) {
                            lastForegroundPackage = "com.google.android.apps.bard"
                            return "com.google.android.apps.bard"
                        }
                        if ("com.android.systemui" != rootPkg) {
                            lastForegroundPackage = rootPkg
                            return rootPkg
                        }
                    }
                } finally {
                    activeRoot.recycle()
                }
            }
        } catch (ignore: Exception) {}

        // 3. Secondary: Inspect interactive application windows in Z-order
        try {
            val winList = windows
            if (!winList.isNullOrEmpty()) {
                // First pass: Active or Focused application window
                for (w in winList) {
                    if (w.type == AccessibilityWindowInfo.TYPE_APPLICATION && (w.isActive || w.isFocused)) {
                        val root = w.root
                        if (root != null) {
                            try {
                                val p = root.packageName
                                if (p != null) {
                                    val pkg = p.toString()
                                    val winTitle = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.P && w.title != null) w.title.toString() else null
                                    val candidateCls = resolveCandidateClass(pkg, if (!winTitle.isNullEmpty()) winTitle else lastActiveActivityClass, root)
                                    if (isSystemOrLauncher(pkg, candidateCls) || pkg == packageName || "com.android.systemui" == pkg) {
                                        // continue
                                    } else if ("com.google.android.googlequicksearchbox" == pkg && isGeminiActive(pkg, null, root) && !isGeminiAllowed()) {
                                        lastForegroundPackage = "com.google.android.apps.bard"
                                        return "com.google.android.apps.bard"
                                    } else if (!isSystemOrLauncher(pkg, candidateCls)) {
                                        lastForegroundPackage = pkg
                                        return pkg
                                    }
                                }
                            } finally {
                                root.recycle()
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                // Second pass: Top visible application window
                for (w in winList) {
                    if (w.type == AccessibilityWindowInfo.TYPE_APPLICATION) {
                        val root = w.root
                        if (root != null) {
                            try {
                                val p = root.packageName
                                if (p != null) {
                                    val pkg = p.toString()
                                    val winTitle = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.P && w.title != null) w.title.toString() else null
                                    val candidateCls = resolveCandidateClass(pkg, if (!winTitle.isNullEmpty()) winTitle else lastActiveActivityClass, root)
                                    if (isSystemOrLauncher(pkg, candidateCls) || pkg == packageName || "com.android.systemui" == pkg) {
                                        // continue
                                    } else if ("com.google.android.googlequicksearchbox" == pkg && isGeminiActive(pkg, null, root) && !isGeminiAllowed()) {
                                        lastForegroundPackage = "com.google.android.apps.bard"
                                        return "com.google.android.apps.bard"
                                    } else if (!isSystemOrLauncher(pkg, candidateCls)) {
                                        lastForegroundPackage = pkg
                                        return pkg
                                    }
                                }
                            } finally {
                                root.recycle()
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (ignore: Exception) {}

        // 4. Fallback: last recorded non-system/non-launcher foreground package from events
        if (lastForegroundPackage != null && !isSystemOrLauncher(lastForegroundPackage, lastActiveActivityClass)) {
            return lastForegroundPackage
        }

        return lastForegroundPackage
    }

    private fun launchLockOverlay() {
        try {
            val launch = packageManager?.getLaunchIntentForPackage(packageName)
            if (launch != null) {
                launch.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK or Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TOP or Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_SINGLE_TOP or Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_REORDER_TO_FRONT)
                val isConsequence = prefs?.getBoolean("consequence_active", false) ?: false
                launch.putExtra("route", if (isConsequence) "logs" else "locked")

                // Android 14/15/16 BAL compliance:
                // Starting an activity directly from background is blocked by OS ActivityTaskManager.
                // Wrap in PendingIntent with MODE_BACKGROUND_ACTIVITY_START_ALLOWED.
                var optionsBundle: android.os.Bundle? = null
                if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.UPSIDE_DOWN_CAKE) {
                    try {
                        val activityOptions = ActivityOptions.makeBasic()
                        val method = activityOptions.javaClass.getMethod("setPendingIntentBackgroundActivityStartMode", Int::class.javaPrimitiveType)
                        method.invoke(activityOptions, 1) // ActivityOptions.MODE_BACKGROUND_ACTIVITY_START_ALLOWED = 1
                        optionsBundle = activityOptions.toBundle()
                    } catch (ignore: Throwable) {}
                }

                val pi = PendingIntent.getActivity(
                    this,
                    0,
                    launch,
                    PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT or PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE
                )
                try {
                    if (optionsBundle != null) {
                        pi.send(this, 0, null, null, null, null, optionsBundle)
                    } else {
                        pi.send()
                    }
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    startActivity(launch)
                }
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "launchLockOverlay failed: ${e.message}")
        }
    }

    private fun handleSystemUiEvent(event: AccessibilityEvent) {
        val classNameChar = event.className ?: return
        val cls = classNameChar.toString().lowercase(Locale.ROOT)

        // Collapse QS tile panel (but allow the plain notification shade)
        if (cls.contains("qs") ||
            cls.contains("quicksetting") ||
            cls.contains("brightnesscontroller") ||
            cls.contains("tilerecord") ||
            cls.contains("quickstatusbar")) {
            collapseQsPanel()
        }
    }

    private fun collapseQsPanel() {
        try {
            val statusBarService = getSystemService("statusbar")
            if (statusBarService != null) {
                val collapseMethod: Method = statusBarService.javaClass.getMethod("collapsePanels")
                collapseMethod.isAccessible = true
                collapseMethod.invoke(statusBarService)
                return
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.w(TAG, "StatusBarManager reflection failed: ${e.message}")
        }
        // Fallback
        try {
            performGlobalAction(GLOBAL_ACTION_BACK)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Fallback collapse failed: ${e.message}")
        }
    }

    private fun checkAndAutoStartScheduledLock(prefs: SharedPreferences): Boolean {
        val schedulesJson = prefs.getString("schedules_json", null)
        if (schedulesJson.isNullOrBlank()) return false

        try {
            val arr = JSONArray(schedulesJson)
            val timeOffset = prefs.getLong("time_offset", 0L)
            val effectiveNow = System.currentTimeMillis() + timeOffset

            for (i in 0 until arr.length()) {
                val s = arr.getJSONObject(i)
                if (!s.optBoolean("isActive", true)) continue

                val timeStr = s.optString("activationTime", "")
                if (!timeStr.contains(":")) continue

                val parts = timeStr.split(":")
                val schedHour = parts[0].trim().toInt()
                val schedMin = parts[1].trim().toInt()
                val durationMinutes = s.optInt("durationMinutes", 25)
                val durationMs = durationMinutes * 60L * 1000L

                val schedCal = Calendar.getInstance().apply {
                    timeInMillis = effectiveNow
                    set(Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY, schedHour)
                    set(Calendar.MINUTE, schedMin)
                    set(Calendar.SECOND, 0)
                    set(Calendar.MILLISECOND, 0)
                }

                val schedStartTime = schedCal.timeInMillis
                val schedEndTime = schedStartTime + durationMs

                // Check today's window
                if (effectiveNow >= schedStartTime && effectiveNow < schedEndTime) {
                    val lastCompletedEnd = prefs.getLong("last_completed_window_end_" + s.optString("id", ""), 0L)
                    if (schedEndTime <= lastCompletedEnd) {
                        continue
                    }
                    prefs.edit()
                        .putBoolean("lockdown_active", true)
                        .putLong("lock_end_time", schedEndTime)
                        .putString("active_schedule_id", s.optString("id", ""))
                        .apply()
                    AlarmReceiver.scheduleLockEndAlarm(this, schedEndTime, s.optString("id", ""))
                    AlarmReceiver.createNotificationChannels(this)
                    AlarmReceiver.showNotificationStatic(
                        this,
                        AlarmReceiver.NOTIF_ID_STATUS,
                        AlarmReceiver.CHANNEL_ID_STATUS,
                        "🔒 QIEZKA Lockdown Engaged",
                        s.optString("title", "Study Session") + " is active (" + durationMinutes + " min). Distracting apps are blocked.",
                        Notification.PRIORITY_HIGH,
                        true
                    )
                    FloatingOverlayService.startService(this, schedEndTime, s.optString("title", "Study Session"))
                    Log.i(TAG, "Native auto-start triggered for schedule: ${s.optString("id", "")}, lockEnd=$schedEndTime")
                    return true
                }

                // Check yesterday's window (crossed midnight)
                val yesterdayStart = schedStartTime - (24L * 3600L * 1000L)
                val yesterdayEnd = yesterdayStart + durationMs
                if (effectiveNow >= yesterdayStart && effectiveNow < yesterdayEnd) {
                    val lastCompletedEnd = prefs.getLong("last_completed_window_end_" + s.optString("id", ""), 0L)
                    if (yesterdayEnd <= lastCompletedEnd) {
                        continue
                    }
                    prefs.edit()
                        .putBoolean("lockdown_active", true)
                        .putLong("lock_end_time", yesterdayEnd)
                        .putString("active_schedule_id", s.optString("id", ""))
                        .apply()
                    AlarmReceiver.scheduleLockEndAlarm(this, yesterdayEnd, s.optString("id", ""))
                    AlarmReceiver.createNotificationChannels(this)
                    AlarmReceiver.showNotificationStatic(
                        this,
                        AlarmReceiver.NOTIF_ID_STATUS,
                        AlarmReceiver.CHANNEL_ID_STATUS,
                        "🔒 QIEZKA Lockdown Engaged",
                        s.optString("title", "Study Session") + " is active (" + durationMinutes + " min). Distracting apps are blocked.",
                        Notification.PRIORITY_HIGH,
                        true
                    )
                    FloatingOverlayService.startService(this, yesterdayEnd, s.optString("title", "Study Session"))
                    Log.i(TAG, "Native auto-start (midnight-cross) triggered for schedule: ${s.optString("id", "")}")
                    return true
                }
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "checkAndAutoStartScheduledLock error: ${e.message}")
        }
        return false
    }

    private fun isHomeAppSelectionPackageOrRoot(pkg: String?, root: AccessibilityNodeInfo?): Boolean {
        return Companion.isHomeAppSelectionPackageOrRoot(this, pkg, root)
    }

    private fun clickCancelOnNode(root: AccessibilityNodeInfo?): Boolean {
        if (root == null) return false
        var dismissed = false
        try {
            // 1. Check "Don't ask again" checkbox if present to permanently deny future role requests
            val dontAskList = root.findAccessibilityNodeInfosByViewId("com.android.permissioncontroller:id/dont_ask_again")
            if (!dontAskList.isNullOrEmpty()) {
                for (cb in dontAskList) {
                    if (cb != null && cb.isCheckable && !cb.isChecked) {
                        cb.performAction(AccessibilityNodeInfo.ACTION_CLICK)
                        Log.i(TAG, "Checked 'Don't ask again' checkbox on role dialog")
                    }
                }
                recycleNodes(dontAskList)
            }

            // 2. Click standard Cancel button (android:id/button2)
            val cancelButtons = root.findAccessibilityNodeInfosByViewId("android:id/button2")
            if (!cancelButtons.isNullOrEmpty()) {
                for (btn in cancelButtons) {
                    if (btn != null && btn.isClickable && btn.isEnabled) {
                        dismissed = btn.performAction(AccessibilityNodeInfo.ACTION_CLICK)
                        Log.i(TAG, "Dismissed home launcher dialog by clicking Cancel button (android:id/button2): $dismissed")
                        if (dismissed) break
                    }
                }
                recycleNodes(cancelButtons)
            }

            // 3. Fallback: text search for "Cancel"
            if (!dismissed) {
                val textCancel = root.findAccessibilityNodeInfosByText("Cancel")
                if (!textCancel.isNullOrEmpty()) {
                    for (btn in textCancel) {
                        if (btn != null && btn.isClickable && btn.isEnabled) {
                            dismissed = btn.performAction(AccessibilityNodeInfo.ACTION_CLICK)
                            Log.i(TAG, "Dismissed home launcher dialog by clicking text 'Cancel': $dismissed")
                            if (dismissed) break
                        }
                    }
                    recycleNodes(textCancel)
                }
            }

            // 4. Fallback for settings pickers with no cancel button (e.g. DefaultHomePicker):
            // Check for SIREN entry and re-select it to preserve SIREN default
            if (!dismissed) {
                val sirenNodes = root.findAccessibilityNodeInfosByText("SIREN")
                if (!sirenNodes.isNullOrEmpty()) {
                    for (sn in sirenNodes) {
                        if (sn != null && sn.isCheckable && !sn.isChecked) {
                            sn.performAction(AccessibilityNodeInfo.ACTION_CLICK)
                            Log.i(TAG, "Re-selected SIREN in home picker")
                            dismissed = true
                            break
                        }
                    }
                    recycleNodes(sirenNodes)
                }
            }
        } catch (ignore: Exception) {}
        return dismissed
    }

    private fun evictHomeLauncherChange() {
        evictHomeLauncherChange(null)
    }

    private fun evictHomeLauncherChange(dialogRoot: AccessibilityNodeInfo?) {
        Log.w(TAG, "🛡️ Intercepted Default Home App / Launcher change attempt! Directly asserting QIEZKA Lock overlay.")

        // 1. Programmatically dismiss dialog via Cancel button click if dialogRoot or activeRoot is available
        var clicked = clickCancelOnNode(dialogRoot)
        if (!clicked && dialogRoot == null) {
            try {
                val activeRoot = rootInActiveWindow
                if (activeRoot != null) {
                    clicked = clickCancelOnNode(activeRoot)
                    activeRoot.recycle()
                }
            } catch (ignore: Exception) {}
        }

        // Anti-Fast-Click Shield: Comprehensive post-inflation & transition cancel retries (10ms to 500ms)
        // Programmatically cancels the dialog across the entire 300ms Android window transition duration
        val retryDelays = longArrayOf(10L, 25L, 50L, 100L, 150L, 200L, 250L, 350L, 500L)
        for (delay in retryDelays) {
            mainHandler.postDelayed({
                try {
                    val r = rootInActiveWindow
                    if (r != null) {
                        try {
                            clickCancelOnNode(r)
                        } finally {
                            r.recycle()
                        }
                    }
                } catch (ignore: Exception) {}
            }, delay)
        }

        // 2. Fallback: if Cancel button click was not confirmed, perform GLOBAL_ACTION_HOME to return to SIREN
        if (!clicked) {
            Log.w(TAG, "Cancel button not confirmed at t=0; performing GLOBAL_ACTION_HOME fallback.")
            performGlobalAction(GLOBAL_ACTION_HOME)
        }

        // 3. Anti-Tamper Toast feedback
        Handler(Looper.getMainLooper()).post {
            Toast.makeText(applicationContext,
                "🛡️ Changing default home launcher is restricted by QIEZKA",
                Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }

        // 4. Re-assert QIEZKA Lock overlay directly (no back press, using BAL-compliant PendingIntent)
        launchLockOverlay()
    }

    override fun onInterrupt() {
        // Required override
    }
}

@CapacitorPlugin(
    name = "LockPlugin",
    permissions = [
        Permission(
            alias = "notifications",
            strings = [android.Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS]
        )

class LockPlugin : Plugin() {

    companion object {
        private const val TAG = "LockPlugin"
        private const val PREFS_NAME = "uncode_lock"

        @JvmStatic
        fun clearLockdownState(context: Context?) {
            if (context == null) return
            try {
                val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                val activeScheduleId = prefs.getString("active_schedule_id", "")
                val timeOffset = prefs.getLong("time_offset", 0L)
                val effectiveNow = System.currentTimeMillis() + timeOffset
                val currentLockEnd = prefs.getLong("lock_end_time", effectiveNow)

                val editor = prefs.edit()
                    .putBoolean("lockdown_active", false)
                    .putBoolean("consequence_active", false)
                    .remove("consequence_schedule_id")
                    .remove("lock_end_time")
                    .remove("active_schedule_id")
                    .putStringSet("whitelist", HashSet<String>())

                if (!activeScheduleId.isNullOrBlank()) {
                    editor.putLong("last_completed_window_end_$activeScheduleId", currentLockEnd)
                    Log.i(TAG, "clearLockdownState: recorded completed window for $activeScheduleId until $currentLockEnd")
                }
                editor.apply()
                AppClassifier.clearCache()

                // 1. Cancel Alarms
                AlarmReceiver.cancelLockEndAlarm(context)

                // 2. Stop Floating Overlay Service
                FloatingOverlayService.stopService(context)

                // 3. Stop Local DNS Sinkhole VPN
                LocalDnsVpnService.stopVpn(context)

                // 4. Cancel Notifications
                val nm = context.getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as? NotificationManager
                if (nm != null) {
                    nm.cancel(AlarmReceiver.NOTIF_ID_STATUS)
                    nm.cancel(AlarmReceiver.NOTIF_ID_COMPLETED)
                }

                Log.i(TAG, "clearLockdownState: complete and authoritative unlock executed successfully")
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                Log.e(TAG, "clearLockdownState error", e)
            }
        }

        @JvmStatic
        fun startConsequenceState(context: Context?, scheduleId: String?, whitelist: Set<String>?) {
            if (context == null) return
            try {
                val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                val editor = prefs.edit()
                    .putBoolean("consequence_active", true)
                    .putBoolean("lockdown_active", true)
                    .remove("lock_end_time")

                if (!scheduleId.isNullOrBlank()) {
                    editor.putString("consequence_schedule_id", scheduleId)
                }
                if (whitelist != null && whitelist.isNotEmpty()) {
                    val cleanWhitelist = HashSet<String>()
                    for (p in whitelist) {
                        if (p != null && !UnifiedPolicyRegistry.isPackageRegisteredInAnyService(p) &&
                            p != "com.google.android.googlequicksearchbox") {
                            cleanWhitelist.add(p)
                        }
                    }
                    editor.putStringSet("whitelist", cleanWhitelist)
                }
                editor.apply()

                // 1. Clear classification cache so whitelist takes immediate effect
                AppClassifier.clearCache()

                // 3. Start Local DNS Sinkhole VPN if configured (Dual Hybrid Mode)
                val webMode = prefs.getString("web_protection_mode", "accessibility")
                if ("dual_hybrid".equals(webMode, ignoreCase = true)) {
                    LocalDnsVpnService.startVpn(context)
                }

                // 4. Start Floating Overlay Service with Consequence Mode indicator
                FloatingOverlayService.startService(context, 0L, "Consequence Mode")

                // 5. Post Status Notification
                val timeOffset = prefs.getLong("time_offset", 0L)
                val effectiveNow = System.currentTimeMillis() + timeOffset
                val inOperatingHours = LockAccessibilityService.isInOperatingHours(context, effectiveNow)
                val isHardcore = "hardcore".equals(prefs.getString("operating_mode", "safemode"), ignoreCase = true)
                val notifMsg = if (isHardcore) {
                    "Distracting apps remain restricted 24/7 (Hardcore Mode) until homework is rescheduled and passed."
                } else {
                    if (inOperatingHours)
                        "Distracting apps are restricted until homework is rescheduled and passed."
                    else
                        "Consequence active: Enforcement paused during daytime (resumes at 7:00 PM)."
                }

                AlarmReceiver.createNotificationChannels(context)
                AlarmReceiver.showNotificationStatic(
                    context,
                    AlarmReceiver.NOTIF_ID_STATUS,
                    AlarmReceiver.CHANNEL_ID_STATUS,
                    "⚠️ QIEZKA Consequence Mode",
                    notifMsg,
                    Notification.PRIORITY_HIGH,
                    true
                )

                // 6. Immediately kick user out if currently inside a blocked app (if in operating hours)
                if (inOperatingHours) {
                    Handler(Looper.getMainLooper()).postDelayed({
                        try {
                            val service = LockAccessibilityService.getInstance()
                            if (service != null) {
                                val activePkg = service.detectCurrentForegroundPackage()
                                if (activePkg != null && service.isPackageBlocked(activePkg)) {
                                    service.enforceBlock(activePkg)
                                }
                            }
                        } catch (_: Exception) {}
                    }, 300L)
                }

                Log.i(TAG, "startConsequenceState: complete consequence enforcement engaged (inOperatingHours=$inOperatingHours)")
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                Log.e(TAG, "startConsequenceState error", e)
            }
        }
    }

    private var dpm: DevicePolicyManager? = null
    private var adminComponent: ComponentName? = null
    private var prefs: SharedPreferences? = null

    override fun load() {
        val act = activity ?: return
        dpm = act.getSystemService(Context.DEVICE_POLICY_SERVICE) as? DevicePolicyManager
        adminComponent = ComponentName(act, AdminReceiver::class.java)
        prefs = act.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
    }

    private fun getLongFromCall(call: PluginCall?, key: String): Long? {
        if (call == null || call.data == null) return null
        val obj = call.data.opt(key)
        if (obj is Number) {
            return obj.toLong()
        }
        if (obj is String) {
            try {
                return obj.toLong()
            } catch (_: NumberFormatException) {}
        }
        return null
    }

    @PluginMethod
    fun startLockdown(call: PluginCall) {
        try {
            val act = activity ?: throw IllegalStateException("Activity not attached")
            val sharedPrefs = prefs ?: act.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            val allowedAppIds = call.getArray("allowedAppIds")
            val rawDuration = call.getInt("durationMinutes", 25) ?: 25
            val durationMinutes = rawDuration.coerceIn(1, 90).toLong()
            val customEndTime = getLongFromCall(call, "lockEndTime")
            val scheduleId = call.getString("scheduleId", "") ?: ""

            val timeOffset = sharedPrefs.getLong("time_offset", 0L)
            val effectiveNow = System.currentTimeMillis() + timeOffset

            val currentlyActive = sharedPrefs.getBoolean("lockdown_active", false)
            val existingEndTime = sharedPrefs.getLong("lock_end_time", 0L)

            var lockEndTime = when {
                customEndTime != null && customEndTime > 0 -> customEndTime
                currentlyActive && existingEndTime > effectiveNow -> {
                    Log.i(TAG, "startLockdown: Preserving active ongoing lockEndTime=$existingEndTime")
                    existingEndTime
                }
                else -> effectiveNow + (durationMinutes * 60L * 1000L)
            }

            val maxAllowedEnd = effectiveNow + (durationMinutes * 60L * 1000L)
            if (lockEndTime > maxAllowedEnd) {
                Log.w(TAG, "startLockdown: Clamping lockEndTime ($lockEndTime) to maxAllowedEnd ($maxAllowedEnd)")
                lockEndTime = maxAllowedEnd
            }

            val whitelist = HashSet<String>()
            whitelist.add(act.packageName) // Always allow QIEZKA itself

            // Always silently whitelist all system and third-party keyboards so typing never bricks lockdown
            try {
                val defaultIme = Settings.Secure.getString(act.contentResolver, Settings.Secure.DEFAULT_INPUT_METHOD)
                if (defaultIme != null && defaultIme.contains("/")) {
                    whitelist.add(defaultIme.split("/")[0])
                }
                val imm = act.getSystemService(Context.INPUT_METHOD_SERVICE) as? InputMethodManager
                if (imm != null) {
                    val imis = imm.inputMethodList
                    if (imis != null) {
                        for (imi in imis) {
                            if (imi?.packageName != null) {
                                whitelist.add(imi.packageName)
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    val enabledImis = imm.enabledInputMethodList
                    if (enabledImis != null) {
                        for (imi in enabledImis) {
                            if (imi?.packageName != null) {
                                whitelist.add(imi.packageName)
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            } catch (_: Exception) {}

            if (allowedAppIds != null) {
                for (i in 0 until allowedAppIds.length()) {
                    val appId = allowedAppIds.getString(i)
                    if (appId != null && !AppClassifier.isSettingsOrDeviceManager(appId, null) &&
                        !AppClassifier.isPwaOrWebApk(appId) &&
                        !UnifiedPolicyRegistry.isPackageRegisteredInAnyService(appId) &&
                        appId != "com.google.android.googlequicksearchbox") {
                        whitelist.add(appId)
                    }
                }
            }

            // Save whitelist and timestamp for AccessibilityService
            sharedPrefs.edit()
                .putStringSet("whitelist", whitelist)
                .putBoolean("lockdown_active", true)
                .putLong("lock_end_time", lockEndTime)
                .putString("active_schedule_id", scheduleId)
                .apply()

            AppClassifier.clearCache()

            // Schedule exact lock end auto-release alarm
            AlarmReceiver.scheduleLockEndAlarm(act, lockEndTime, scheduleId)

            // Start Floating Assistive Timer Ball Overlay
            FloatingOverlayService.startService(act, lockEndTime, scheduleId)

            // Start Local DNS Sinkhole if web protection mode is dual_hybrid
            val webMode = sharedPrefs.getString("web_protection_mode", "accessibility")
            if ("dual_hybrid".equals(webMode, ignoreCase = true)) {
                LocalDnsVpnService.startVpn(act)
            }

            val ret = JSObject()
            ret.put("lockEndTime", lockEndTime)
            call.resolve(ret)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "startLockdown failed", e)
            call.reject("startLockdown failed: " + e.message)
        }
    }

    @PluginMethod
    fun endLockdown(call: PluginCall) {
        try {
            clearLockdownState(activity)
            call.resolve()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "endLockdown failed", e)
            call.reject("endLockdown failed: " + e.message)
        }
    }

    @PluginMethod
    fun setConsequenceActive(call: PluginCall) {
        try {
            val active = call.getBoolean("active", false) ?: false
            val scheduleId = call.getString("scheduleId", "") ?: ""

            if (active) {
                val rawWhitelist = call.getArray("whitelist")
                val whitelist = HashSet<String>()
                if (rawWhitelist != null) {
                    for (i in 0 until rawWhitelist.length()) {
                        whitelist.add(rawWhitelist.getString(i))
                    }
                }
                startConsequenceState(activity, scheduleId, whitelist)
            } else {
                clearLockdownState(activity)
            }
            call.resolve()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "setConsequenceActive failed", e)
            call.reject("setConsequenceActive failed: " + e.message)
        }
    }

    @PluginMethod
    fun setWebProtectionMode(call: PluginCall) {
        try {
            val rawMode = call.getString("mode", "accessibility")
            val mode = if ("dual_hybrid".equals(rawMode, ignoreCase = true)) "dual_hybrid" else "accessibility"
            val act = activity
            val sharedPrefs = prefs ?: act?.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            sharedPrefs?.edit()?.putString("web_protection_mode", mode)?.apply()
            Log.i(TAG, "Web protection mode set to: $mode")

            val isLockActive = (sharedPrefs?.getBoolean("lockdown_active", false) == true) ||
                               (sharedPrefs?.getBoolean("consequence_active", false) == true)
            if (isLockActive && act != null) {
                if ("dual_hybrid".equals(mode, ignoreCase = true)) {
                    LocalDnsVpnService.startVpn(act)
                } else {
                    LocalDnsVpnService.stopVpn(act)
                }
            } else if (act != null) {
                LocalDnsVpnService.stopVpn(act)
            }

            val ret = JSObject()
            ret.put("success", true)
            call.resolve(ret)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "setWebProtectionMode failed", e)
            call.reject("setWebProtectionMode failed: " + e.message)
        }
    }

    @PluginMethod
    fun setAllowYoutube(call: PluginCall) {
        try {
            val allow = call.getBoolean("allow", false) == true
            val sharedPrefs = prefs ?: activity?.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            val currentServices = sharedPrefs?.getStringSet("active_unified_services", HashSet<String>()) ?: HashSet<String>()
            val activeServices = HashSet<String>(currentServices)
            if (allow) {
                activeServices.add("youtube")
            } else {
                activeServices.remove("youtube")
            }

            val domains = UnifiedPolicyRegistry.getDomainsForServices(activeServices)

            sharedPrefs?.edit()
                ?.putBoolean("allow_youtube", allow)
                ?.putStringSet("active_unified_services", activeServices)
                ?.putStringSet("allowed_domains", domains)
                ?.apply()

            AppClassifier.clearCache()
            WebClassifier.clearCache()
            Log.i(TAG, "Allow YouTube set to: $allow (active_unified_services=$activeServices)")
            val ret = JSObject()
            ret.put("success", true)
            call.resolve(ret)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "setAllowYoutube failed", e)
            call.reject("setAllowYoutube failed: " + e.message)
        }
    }

    @PluginMethod
    fun setServicePolicy(call: PluginCall) {
        try {
            val serviceId = call.getString("serviceId", "")
            if (serviceId.isNullOrBlank()) {
                call.reject("serviceId is required")
                return
            }
            val key = serviceId.lowercase(Locale.US).trim()
            val allowed = call.getBoolean("allowed", false) == true

            val sharedPrefs = prefs ?: activity?.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            val currentServices = sharedPrefs?.getStringSet("active_unified_services", HashSet<String>()) ?: HashSet<String>()
            val activeServices = HashSet<String>(currentServices)
            if (allowed) {
                activeServices.add(key)
            } else {
                activeServices.remove(key)
            }

            val editor = sharedPrefs?.edit()
            editor?.putStringSet("active_unified_services", activeServices)
            if ("youtube" == key) {
                editor?.putBoolean("allow_youtube", allowed)
            }
            val domains = UnifiedPolicyRegistry.getDomainsForServices(activeServices)
            editor?.putStringSet("allowed_domains", domains)
            editor?.apply()

            AppClassifier.clearCache()
            WebClassifier.clearCache()

            Log.i(TAG, "Unified service policy updated: $key=$allowed (active=$activeServices)")

            val ret = JSObject()
            ret.put("success", true)
            val activeArr = JSArray()
            for (s in activeServices) {
                activeArr.put(s)
            }
            ret.put("activeServices", activeArr)
            call.resolve(ret)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "setServicePolicy failed", e)
            call.reject("setServicePolicy failed: " + e.message)
        }
    }

    @PluginMethod
    fun getRegisteredServices(call: PluginCall) {
        try {
            val servicesArr = JSArray()
            for (svc in UnifiedPolicyRegistry.SERVICES.values) {
                val obj = JSObject()
                obj.put("id", svc.id)
                obj.put("name", svc.displayName)
                obj.put("displayName", svc.displayName)
                obj.put("description", svc.description)
                obj.put("badge", svc.badge)
                obj.put("iconName", svc.iconName)
                obj.put("themeColor", svc.themeColor)

                val pkgArr = JSArray()
                for (p in svc.packages) {
                    pkgArr.put(p)
                }
                obj.put("packages", pkgArr)

                val domainArr = JSArray()
                for (d in svc.domains) {
                    domainArr.put(d)
                }
                obj.put("domains", domainArr)

                servicesArr.put(obj)
            }
            val ret = JSObject()
            ret.put("services", servicesArr)
            call.resolve(ret)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "getRegisteredServices failed", e)
            call.reject("getRegisteredServices failed: " + e.message)
        }
    }

    @PluginMethod
    fun setBlockWebGames(call: PluginCall) {

            ret.put("success", true)
            call.resolve(ret)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "setBlockWebGames failed", e)
            call.reject("setBlockWebGames failed: " + e.message)
        }
    }

    @PluginMethod
    fun requestVpnPermission(call: PluginCall) {
        try {
            val act = activity ?: throw IllegalStateException("Activity not attached")
            val vpnIntent = VpnService.prepare(act)
            if (vpnIntent == null) {
                val ret = JSObject()
                ret.put("granted", true)
                call.resolve(ret)
            } else {
                startActivityForResult(call, vpnIntent, "vpnPermissionCallback")
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "requestVpnPermission failed", e)
            val ret = JSObject()
            ret.put("granted", false)
            call.resolve(ret)
        }
    }

    @ActivityCallback
    private fun vpnPermissionCallback(call: PluginCall?, result: ActivityResult?) {
        val ret = JSObject()
        val granted = result != null && result.resultCode == Activity.RESULT_OK
        ret.put("granted", granted)
        call?.resolve(ret)
    }

    @PluginMethod
    fun getLockStatus(call: PluginCall) {
        try {
            val sharedPrefs = prefs ?: activity?.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            var isActive = sharedPrefs?.getBoolean("lockdown_active", false) == true
            val isConsequence = sharedPrefs?.getBoolean("consequence_active", false) == true
            val lockEndTime = sharedPrefs?.getLong("lock_end_time", 0L) ?: 0L
            val scheduleId = sharedPrefs?.getString("active_schedule_id", "") ?: ""

            val timeOffset = sharedPrefs?.getLong("time_offset", 0L) ?: 0L
            val effectiveNow = System.currentTimeMillis() + timeOffset

            // Native timestamp auto-expire only when NOT in consequence mode
            if (isActive && !isConsequence && lockEndTime > 0 && effectiveNow >= lockEndTime) {
                isActive = false
                clearLockdownState(activity)
            }

            val ret = JSObject()
            ret.put("isLockActive", isActive)
            ret.put("isConsequenceActive", isConsequence)
            ret.put("lockEndTime", lockEndTime)
            ret.put("activeScheduleId", scheduleId)
            call.resolve(ret)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "getLockStatus failed", e)
            call.reject("getLockStatus failed: " + e.message)
        }
    }

    @PluginMethod
    fun syncTimeOffset(call: PluginCall) {
        try {
            val timeOffset = getLongFromCall(call, "timeOffset") ?: 0L
            val sharedPrefs = prefs ?: activity?.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            sharedPrefs?.edit()?.putLong("time_offset", timeOffset)?.apply()
            Log.i(TAG, "Synchronized timeOffset to native: ${timeOffset}ms")

            activity?.let { ScheduleManager.rescheduleAll(it) }

            val ret = JSObject()
            ret.put("success", true)
            call.resolve(ret)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "syncTimeOffset failed", e)
            call.reject("syncTimeOffset failed: " + e.message)
        }
    }

    @PluginMethod
    fun syncSchedules(call: PluginCall) {
        try {
            val act = activity ?: throw IllegalStateException("Activity not attached")
            val schedulesArr = call.getArray("schedules")
            val allowedAppIds = call.getArray("allowedAppIds")

            val schedulesJson = schedulesArr?.toString() ?: "[]"

            val whitelist = HashSet<String>()
            whitelist.add(act.packageName)
            if (allowedAppIds != null) {
                for (i in 0 until allowedAppIds.length()) {
                    val appId = allowedAppIds.getString(i)
                    if (appId != null && !AppClassifier.isSettingsOrDeviceManager(appId, null)) {
                        whitelist.add(appId)
                    }
                }
            }

            ScheduleManager.syncSchedules(act, schedulesJson, whitelist)
            AppClassifier.clearCache()

            val ret = JSObject()
            ret.put("success", true)
            call.resolve(ret)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "syncSchedules failed", e)
            call.reject("syncSchedules failed: " + e.message)
        }
    }

    @PluginMethod
    fun getInstalledApps(call: PluginCall) {
        val task = Runnable {
            try {
                val act = activity ?: run {
                    call.reject("Activity unavailable")
                    return@Runnable
                }
                val pm = act.packageManager
                val myPkg = act.packageName

                // 1. Single-pass pre-queries (run once, not inside any package loop)
                val browserPackages = HashSet<String>()
                try {
                    val browserIntent = Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW, Uri.parse("https://www.google.com"))
                    browserIntent.addCategory(Intent.CATEGORY_BROWSABLE)
                    val bList = pm.queryIntentActivities(browserIntent, 0)
                    for (r in bList) {
                        r.activityInfo?.packageName?.let { browserPackages.add(it) }
                    }
                } catch (_: Exception) {}

                val musicPackages = HashSet<String>()
                try {
                    val musicIntent = Intent(Intent.ACTION_MAIN)
                    musicIntent.addCategory(Intent.CATEGORY_APP_MUSIC)
                    val mList = pm.queryIntentActivities(musicIntent, 0)
                    for (r in mList) {
                        r.activityInfo?.packageName?.let { musicPackages.add(it) }
                    }
                    val audioIntent = Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW)
                    audioIntent.setDataAndType(Uri.parse("file://test.mp3"), "audio/*")
                    val aList = pm.queryIntentActivities(audioIntent, 0)
                    for (r in aList) {
                        r.activityInfo?.packageName?.let { musicPackages.add(it) }
                    }
                } catch (_: Exception) {}

                val cameraPackages = HashSet<String>()
                try {
                    val cameraIntent = Intent(MediaStore.ACTION_IMAGE_CAPTURE)
                    val cList = pm.queryIntentActivities(cameraIntent, 0)
                    for (r in cList) {
                        r.activityInfo?.packageName?.let { cameraPackages.add(it) }
                    }
                } catch (_: Exception) {}

                val keyboardPackages = HashSet<String>()
                try {
                    val defaultIme = Settings.Secure.getString(act.contentResolver, Settings.Secure.DEFAULT_INPUT_METHOD)
                    if (defaultIme != null && defaultIme.contains("/")) {
                        keyboardPackages.add(defaultIme.split("/")[0])
                    }
                    val imm = act.getSystemService(Context.INPUT_METHOD_SERVICE) as? InputMethodManager
                    if (imm != null) {
                        val imis = imm.inputMethodList
                        if (imis != null) {
                            for (imi in imis) {
                                if (imi?.packageName != null) {
                                    keyboardPackages.add(imi.packageName)
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                } catch (_: Exception) {}

                // 2. Query user-launchable apps directly to avoid iterating hundreds of hidden system daemons
                val launcherIntent = Intent(Intent.ACTION_MAIN)
                launcherIntent.addCategory(Intent.CATEGORY_LAUNCHER)
                val launcherList = pm.queryIntentActivities(launcherIntent, 0)

                val candidatePackages = LinkedHashSet<String>()
                for (r in launcherList) {
                    r.activityInfo?.packageName?.let { candidatePackages.add(it) }
                }
                candidatePackages.addAll(browserPackages)
                candidatePackages.addAll(musicPackages)
                candidatePackages.addAll(cameraPackages)

                val apps = JSArray()
                val addedPackages = HashSet<String>()

                for (pkg in candidatePackages) {
                    if (pkg == null || pkg == myPkg || addedPackages.contains(pkg)) {
                        continue
                    }
                    if (AppClassifier.isSettingsOrDeviceManager(pkg, null) ||
                        AppClassifier.isStage1Bloat(pkg, null) ||
                        AppClassifier.isForbiddenDistraction(act, pkg) ||
                        AppClassifier.isPwaOrWebApk(pkg) ||
                        KnownDistracting.isKnownDistracting(pkg)) {
                        continue // Strictly omit anti-tamper, bloatware, games, PWAs/WebAPKs, and social media from candidate selection
                    }
                    val isBaselineSafe = KnownSafe.BASELINE_SAFE_PACKAGES.contains(pkg)
                    if (!isBaselineSafe && (UnifiedPolicyRegistry.isPackageRegisteredInAnyService(pkg) || isAiAppKeywords(pkg, null))) {
                        continue // Governed strictly via Unified Service Policy Engine in Settings
                    }
                    if (keyboardPackages.contains(pkg) || isKeyboardAppKeywords(pkg)) {
                        continue // Keyboards are silently exempted in lockdown, hidden from whitelist UI
                    }

                    try {
                        val appInfo = pm.getApplicationInfo(pkg, 0)
                        val appLabel = pm.getApplicationLabel(appInfo).toString()

                        if (isHiddenInfrastructureApp(pkg, appLabel)) {
                            continue // Hide camera extension proxies, aperture lens launchers, etc.
                        }
                        if (AppClassifier.isSettingsOrDeviceManager(pkg, appLabel) ||
                            AppClassifier.isStage1Bloat(pkg, appLabel) ||
                            AppClassifier.isPwaOrWebApk(pkg) ||
                            KnownDistracting.isKnownDistracting(pkg, appLabel) ||
                            (!isBaselineSafe && isAiAppKeywords(pkg, appLabel))) {
                            continue
                        }

                        val isLauncher = KnownSafe.isLauncherApp(act, pkg)
                        if (isLauncher) {
                            continue // Home Launchers have their own dedicated section in Settings; do not display in Allowed Apps
                        }

                        // Stage 3 Universal System Gateway (SYSALLOW) UI Non-Rendering Principle:
                        if (AppClassifier.isPassedStage3SystemAllow(appInfo, pkg, appLabel)) {
                            continue
                        }

                        val isHardcoded = KnownSafe.isHardcodedApp(act, appInfo, pkg, appLabel)

                        // Strict Whitelist Invariant: User can ONLY whitelist apps that are in KnownSafe or detected as safe
                        if (!isHardcoded && !isBaselineSafe && AppClassifier.isPackageBlocked(act, pkg, null)) {
                            continue // Omit unverified or distracting third-party apps
                        }

                        val isBrowser = browserPackages.contains(pkg) || isBrowserAppKeywords(pkg)
                        val isMusic = musicPackages.contains(pkg) || isMusicAppKeywords(pkg)
                        val isCamera = cameraPackages.contains(pkg) || isCameraAppKeywords(pkg)
                        val isAuthenticator = isAuthenticatorAppKeywords(pkg, appLabel)
                        val isNotes = isNotesAppKeywords(pkg, appLabel)
                        val isStudentApp = isBaselineSafe || isStudentAppKeywords(pkg, appLabel)
                        val isAi = isAiAppKeywords(pkg, appLabel)
                        val isMessaging = AppClassifier.isMessagingApp(pkg, appLabel)

                        addedPackages.add(pkg)

                        val app = JSObject()
                        app.put("id", pkg)
                        app.put("name", appLabel)

                        val isSimOrCarrier = AppClassifier.isSimOrCarrierService(pkg, appLabel)

                        var iconName = "LayoutGrid"
                        if (isLauncher) iconName = "Home"
                        else if (isBrowser) iconName = "Globe"
                        else if (isMusic) iconName = "Music"
                        else if (isCamera) iconName = "Camera"
                        else if (isAuthenticator) iconName = "ShieldCheck"
                        else if (isAi) iconName = "Sparkles"
                        else if (isNotes) iconName = "FileText"
                        else if (isStudentApp) iconName = "BookOpen"
                        else if (isMessaging || isSimOrCarrier) iconName = "MessageSquare"

                        val isAutoAllowed = !isHardcoded && !isLauncher

                        app.put("iconName", iconName)
                        app.put("isHardcoded", isHardcoded)
                        app.put("isLauncher", isLauncher)
                        app.put("isAutoAllowed", isAutoAllowed)
                        app.put("isMessaging", isMessaging)
                        app.put("isBrowser", isBrowser)
                        app.put("isMusic", isMusic)
                        app.put("isCamera", isCamera)
                        app.put("isAuthenticator", isAuthenticator)
                        app.put("isNotes", isNotes)
                        app.put("isStudentApp", isStudentApp)
                        app.put("isAi", isAi)

                        try {
                            val icon = pm.getApplicationIcon(appInfo)
                            val base64Icon = getBase64Icon(icon)
                            if (base64Icon != null) {
                                app.put("iconBase64", base64Icon)
                            }
                        } catch (_: Exception) {}

                        apps.put(app)
                    } catch (_: PackageManager.NameNotFoundException) {}
                }

                val result = JSObject()
                result.put("apps", apps)
                call.resolve(result)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                Log.e(TAG, "getInstalledApps failed", e)
                call.reject("getInstalledApps failed: " + e.message)
            }
        }

        if (bridge != null) {
            bridge.execute(task)
        } else {
            Thread(task).start()
        }
    }

    private fun isAuthenticatorAppKeywords(packageName: String?, label: String?): Boolean {
        if (packageName != null) {
            val lower = packageName.lowercase(Locale.US)
            if (lower.contains("authenticator") || lower.contains("twofas") || lower.contains("duomobile") || lower.contains("yubioath")) {
                return true
            }
        }
        if (label != null) {
            val lowerLabel = label.lowercase(Locale.US)
            if (lowerLabel.contains("authenticator") || lowerLabel.contains("2fa") || lowerLabel.contains("otp")) {
                return true
            }
        }
        return false
    }

    private fun isNotesAppKeywords(packageName: String?, label: String?): Boolean {
        if (packageName != null) {
            val lower = packageName.lowercase(Locale.US)
            if (lower.contains("keep") || lower.contains("onenote") || lower.contains("obsidian") ||
                lower.contains("notion") || lower.contains("notepad") || lower.contains(".notes") ||
                lower.contains("memo") || lower.contains("simplenote") || lower.contains("colornote")) {
                return true
            }
        }
        if (label != null) {
            val lowerLabel = label.lowercase(Locale.US)
            if (lowerLabel.contains("notes") || lowerLabel.contains("notepad") || lowerLabel.contains("memo") ||
                lowerLabel.contains("keep") || lowerLabel.contains("onenote") || lowerLabel.contains("notion") ||
                lowerLabel.contains("obsidian") || lowerLabel.contains("journal")) {
                return true
            }
        }
        return false
    }

                lower.contains("claude") || lower.contains("copilot") || lower.contains("perplexity") ||
                lower.contains("deepseek") || lower.contains(".poe") || lower.contains("grok")) {
                return true
            }
        }
        if (label != null) {
            val lowerLabel = label.lowercase(Locale.US)
            if (lowerLabel.contains("chatgpt") || lowerLabel.contains("gemini") || lowerLabel.contains("claude") ||
                lowerLabel.contains("copilot") || lowerLabel.contains("perplexity") || lowerLabel.contains("deepseek") ||
                lowerLabel.contains("ai assistant") || lowerLabel.contains("poe") || lowerLabel.contains("grok")) {
